spans.text: More young Koreans begin careers in nonregular jobs
spans.gt_tgt: 첫 일자리 비정규직 출발한 청년, 10년중 3년만 정규직 근무
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: One in three South Koreans born between 1989 and 1998 started their careers in nonregular jobs, according to a report. Despite a sharp rise in educational attainment across generations, this group was nearly twice as likely to begin working in nonregular employment as people born between 1969 and 1978, who entered the labor market around the 1997 Asian financial crisis.
spans.gt_tgt: 지난해 2월 대학을 졸업한 뒤 금융 정보기술(IT) 분야에 취업하려고 1년 7개월째 준비 중인 조모 씨(28)는 인공지능(AI) 등의 영향으로 채용 문이 크게 좁아졌지만 정규직을 고집하고 있다. 첫 직장에 정규직으로 입사하는 것 자체가 향후 고용 안정성, 경력 성장 등에 크게 영향을 미치기 때문이다. 조 씨는 “비정규직은 두 자릿수로 뽑아도 정규직은 여러 분야를 합쳐 한 자릿수만 선발할 때가 많다”며 “하지만 취업 준비가 더 길어져도 처음부터 경력으로 인정받을 정규직 일자리를 찾을 수밖에 없다”고 말했다.

spans.text: Seoul bus union faces scrutiny over strike penalties
spans.gt_tgt: [단독]16일 파업 돌입 예고한 서울버스노조 “불참땐 학자금-복지포인트 없다” 압박

spans.text: The Seoul bus workers' union, which has called a strike for Sept. 16, has told its local chapters that drivers and other union members who refuse to join the walkout will be denied benefits such as education assistance and welfare points. The Seoul Metropolitan Government says the measure could be illegal and has asked the employers' group to review the matter.
spans.gt_tgt: 16일 파업을 예고한 서울버스노조가 파업에 불참하는 운전사 등에게 학자금, 복지포인트 등의 혜택을 지급하지 않겠다고 각 지부에 통보했다. 서울시는 이런 조치가 위법 소지가 있다고 보고 사 측에 법률 검토를 요청했다.

spans.text: Red Sea threat deepens global supply risks
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: Fears of a broader security and economic crisis in the Middle East are growing as Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthi rebels take control of the strategic port of Mocha and the Hanish Islands at the entrance to the Red Sea. With the Strait of Hormuz effectively closed to shipping amid the U.S.-Iran war, global trade faces a “double bottleneck” as another vital gateway, the Red Sea, comes under threat. Oil prices have also climbed back above $100 a barrel, while prices for a wide range of commodities are rising in an unusual “everything rally.”
spans.gt_tgt: 예멘의 친이란 무장단체 후티 반군이 홍해 입구의 전략 요충지인 모카 항구와 하니시 제도를 장악하면서 중동발 안보·경제 위기감이 한층 커지고 있다. 미국-이란 전쟁으로 호르무즈 해협의 통항이 사실상 막힌 상황에서 우회 수송로인 홍해 관문마저 위협받는 ‘이중 병목’ 위기가 현실화한 것이다. 여기에 국제유가가 배럴당 100달러를 다시 넘어섰을 뿐만 아니라 각종 원자재 가격이 일제히 치솟는 이례적인 ‘에브리싱 랠리’까지 펼쳐지고 있다.

spans.text: New guidelines narrow labor dispute scope
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: The government has ruled that management decisions such as performance bonuses tied to corporate earnings, including “N% bonuses,” and plans to build new semiconductor plants in the Honam region do not fall under mandatory bargaining or labor disputes covered by the Yellow Envelope Law, the amended Trade Union and Labor Relations Adjustment Act. The guidelines, however, are unlikely to end the dispute. They are not legally binding, and both labor and management have strongly opposed them, raising concerns that uncertainty will persist in workplaces.
spans.gt_tgt: 기업 이익과 연동된 ‘N% 성과급’이나 ‘호남 반도체 공장 신설’ 같은 경영상의 결정은 노란봉투법(개정 노동조합법)에 따른 의무 교섭 및 노동쟁의 대상이 아니라는 정부 시행지침이 나왔다. 하지만 시행지침의 법적 구속력이 없는 데다 노사 모두 강하게 반발하고 있어 산업 현장의 혼란이 계속될 것이라는 우려가 크다.

spans.text: Police uncover terror financing scheme involving foreigners
spans.gt_tgt: 중고차 무역 위장해 테러단체 지원 외국인 검거
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: Foreign nationals staying in South Korea were found to have received cryptocurrency from a terrorist group operating in Syria, used the funds to buy used cars and excavators in South Korea, and shipped them to Syria. It is the first known case in South Korea of a foreign national residing in the country using money from a terrorist group to purchase equipment and send it to the group overseas.
spans.gt_tgt: 국내에 체류하던 외국인들이 시리아에서 활동하는 테러 단체로부터 가상자산을 받아 한국에서 중고차와 굴착기를 산 뒤 시리아로 보낸 사실이 적발됐다. 국내 체류 외국인이 테러 단체로부터 받은 자금으로 장비를 구입해 현지에 제공한 사례가 적발된 것은 처음이다.

spans.text: South Korea’s National Employment Support Program left four in 10 participants still unemployed last year despite a budget of more than 1 trillion won. Its employment rate has remained in the 50% range every year since the program was launched in 2021, except for its first year.

spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: The Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment announced Aug. 27 that it will build five new dams: the Jicheon Dam in Cheongyang and Buyeo, South Chungcheong Province; the Amicheon Dam in Yeoncheon, Gyeonggi Province; the Byeongyeongcheon Dam in Gwangju and Gangjin, South Jeolla Province; the Hoeyagang Dam in Ulsan; and the Gohyeoncheon Dam in Geoje, South Gyeongsang Province. In September last year, the ministry scrapped seven of the 14 dams proposed by the previous administration and said it would reconsider the other seven. A year later, five are moving ahead and two have been dropped.
spans.gt_tgt: 기후에너지환경부가 신규 댐 5개 건설 계획을 27일 발표했다. 지천댐(충남 청양·부여), 아미천댐(경기 연천), 병영천댐(전남광주 강진), 회야강댐(울산), 고현천댐(경남 거제)이 그 대상이다. 기후부는 지난해 9월 지난 정부가 발표한 신규 댐 14개 중 7개를 백지화하고, 7개는 재검토하겠다고 밝힌 바 있다. 이후 일 년 만에 5개는 건설하고 2개는 짓지 않기로 결정한 것이다.

spans.text: Agency mergers could trigger leadership shakeup
spans.gt_tgt: 통폐합 공공기관장 교체 불가피…尹정부 인사 임기 못채울 듯
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: The government’s plan to merge or consolidate about 20% of the country’s public institutions is expected to trigger a major shake-up among agency heads and senior executives. The government has pledged to protect the jobs of roughly 120,000 employees at the institutions targeted for consolidation and continue hiring, but significant disruption within the agencies is likely. There is also speculation that agency heads appointed under the Yoon Suk Yeol administration could be forced out.
spans.gt_tgt: 정부가 공공기관 109곳을 통폐합하기로 하면서 윤석열 정부 때 임명된 기관장들이 임기를 채우지 못하고 교체될 가능성이 커졌다. 기관장 자리만 100개 안팎이 사라질 것이란 관측이 나오는 가운데 고용 승계가 보장된 직원들 사이에서도 임금과 보직, 근무지 변화에 대한 불안이 커지고 있다. 정부는 우선 발전공기업 5사를 ‘한국발전’(가칭)으로 합쳐 내년 10월 출범시킨다는 계획이다.

spans.text: Election probe must put facts first
spans.gt_tgt: 선관위 특검 출범… 투표용지 부족 등 12개 의혹 수사
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: A special counsel investigation into the National Election Commission began Monday, focusing on the ballot shortage during the June 3 local elections and 11 other allegations. The probe will examine why the minimum number of ballots printed was lowered, a decision blamed for the shortage, as well as allegations that voter turnout figures were manipulated. It will also look into alleged favoritism in no-bid contracts, questionable overseas trips and hiring irregularities. The special counsel has 90 days to complete its work, with two possible 30-day extensions, allowing the investigation to run for up to 150 days.
spans.gt_tgt: 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 등 선거관리위원회를 둘러싼 각종 의혹을 규명할 선관위 특검(특별검사 이태한)이 7일 공식 출범했다. 특검은 최장 150일간 투표용지 부족과 통계 조작을 비롯해 외유성 출장, 부정 채용·승진, 수의계약 특혜 등 12개 의혹을 수사한다.

spans.text: Korean farming emerges as a growth industry
spans.gt_tgt: [사설]세계로 뻗는 K푸드… AI 전환-스마트 창업으로 승부 걸어야
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: South Korean agriculture is at a turning point as it develops into a technology-driven industry. The global K-culture boom has put Korean food and farm products in the spotlight overseas. Meanwhile, two of rural Korea’s most persistent problems, an aging population and the prevalence of small-scale farms, are beginning to see new solutions through artificial intelligence and the arrival of younger farmers. The 2026 A FARM SHOW, an exhibition centered on starting farms, returning to farming and supporting hometowns, opened Friday at the aT Center in Seoul’s Seocho District, offering a snapshot of how the sector is changing.
spans.gt_tgt: 한국 농업이 혁신 산업으로 진화하며 커다란 전환점을 맞고 있다. K컬처 열풍에 힘입어 한국의 식품과 농산물에 대한 세계 시장의 주목도가 그 어느 때보다 높다. 우리 농촌의 고질적인 한계인 고령화와 영세화는 인공지능(AI) 기술과 청년들의 유입으로 돌파구를 찾고 있다. 28일 서울 서초구 aT센터에서 개막한 ‘2026 A FARM SHOW(에이팜쇼)―창농·귀농 고향사랑 박람회’는 역동적으로 변화하는 농업의 현재와 미래를 한눈에 보여주고 있다.

spans.text: South Korea plans massive future investment fund
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: The government plans to create a “Future Response Fund” with a tax windfall from the semiconductor boom, using the money to invest in advanced industries, young people and other areas considered key to future growth. It will also overhaul the way local education subsidies are distributed, ending the automatic allocation of 20.79% of domestic tax revenue and redirecting the savings to early childhood education, universities and lifelong learning. The fund could reach 100 trillion to 150 trillion won.
spans.gt_tgt: 정부가 반도체 초호황으로 걷힌 추가 세수를 활용해 첨단 산업과 청년 등에 투자하는 ‘미래대응기금’을 신설한다. 지방교육재정교부금은 내국세의 20.79%를 자동으로 배분하던 방식을 폐지하고, 이를 통해 확보한 여윳돈을 영유아와 대학·평생교육에 투자한다. 기금 규모는 150조 원을 넘을 것으로 예상된다.

spans.text: Steel highlights her family ties to South Korea
spans.gt_tgt: 관저 공개한 스틸 “참전용사 덕분에 부모님 월남”
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: U.S. Ambassador to South Korea Michelle Steel highlighted those words in a video posted on Aug. 21 introducing Habib House, the U.S. ambassador’s residence in Seoul. Steel shared the story of her parents, who were displaced from North Korea and fled to South Korea during the Korean War. In the video posted by the U.S. Embassy in Seoul on X, formerly Twitter, she said the courage and sacrifice of the veterans honored at the National Cemetery allowed her parents to build a new life in Seoul amid the turmoil of war. “Through their experience, I learned how important the bonds between nations are,” she said.
spans.gt_tgt: 미셸 스틸 주한 미국대사가 21일 주한미국대사관저 ‘하비브 하우스(Habib house)’를 소개하는 영상에서 실향민 출신인 부모가 6·25전쟁 당시 북한을 탈출해 한국으로 온 경험을 전하며 이렇게 강조했다. 주한미국대사관이 X(옛 트위터)에 공개한 영상에서 그는 “현충원에 모신 참전용사분들의 용기와 희생 덕분에 부모님이 전쟁의 혼란 속에서도 서울에서 새 삶을 시작할 수 있었다”며 “이를 통해 국가 간 유대가 매우 중요하다는 걸 배웠다”고 했다.

spans.text: This essay is by a professional photographer who has spent more than 30 years documenting cultural heritage sites in South Korea and abroad. spans.text: Lee administration unveils expansionary 2026 budget plan
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: The first budget proposal of the Lee Jae-myung administration has been set at 728 trillion won, an 8.1 percent increase from the previous year. This marks the highest growth rate since the 2022 main budget under the Moon Jae-in administration, which rose by 8.9 percent. It also signals an end to the austerity stance of former President Yoon Suk Yeol’s administration, which had maintained budget growth of only 2 to 3 percent, and a return to expansionary fiscal policy. As a result, national debt is projected to surpass 1,400 trillion won next year, with the debt-to-GDP ratio expected to exceed 50 percent for the first time.
spans.gt_tgt: 이재명 정부의 첫 예산안 규모가 전년보다 8.1% 늘어난 728조 원으로 편성됐다. 8%대 증가율은 문재인 정부 시절 편성한 2022년 본예산(8.9%) 이후 가장 높은 수치다. 2∼3% 증가율을 보였던 전임 윤석열 정부의 긴축 기조에 마침표를 찍고 다시 확장 재정으로 돌아선 것이다. 이에 따라 내년 국가채무 규모가 1400조 원을 돌파하고, 국내총생산(GDP) 대비 국가채무비율도 처음으로 50%를 넘어설 것으로 전망된다.

spans.text: Money Lending Act amendment bill to begin this month

spans.text: The ruling and opposition parties will advance an amendment to the Money Lending Act that nullifies both principal and interest on anti-social loan contracts involving bodily harm, assault, threats, human trafficking, and sexual exploitation. Unregistered money lenders will now be clearly defined as illegal private lenders. To curb the rise of small-scale money lending businesses, the equity capital requirement for lenders will increase from 10 million won to 100 million won for individuals and from 50 million won to 300 million won for corporations. The Democratic Party of Korea aims to make eradicating illegal private lending a key legislative priority, increasing the likelihood that related bills will be addressed in the September session. After the Dong-A Ilbo Hero Content Team's series of articles titled "Trap: Caught in a Money Trap," which exposed the reality of illegal loan sharking organizations, the government and the National Assembly have begun to push for comprehensive measures in earnest.
spans.gt_tgt: 당정이 신체 상해와 폭행·협박, 인신매매, 성착취 추심 등에 의한 반사회적 대부 계약에 대해 원금과 이자를 무효화하는 내용의 대부업법 개정을 추진하기로 했다. 미등록 대부업자의 법적 명칭은 불법 사금융업자로 변경하기로 했다. 불법에 해당하는 미등록 업자를 명백하게 불법으로 규정짓겠다는 취지다. 영세 대부업 난립에 따른 피해를 방지하기 위해 대부업체의 자기자본 요건은 개인 1000만 원에서 1억 원, 법인 5000만 원에서 3억 원으로 상향한다. 더불어민주당도 불법 사채 근절을 위한 대부업법 개정안을 당 중점 법안으로 추진하기로 하면서 9월 정기국회에서 관련 법안이 처리될 가능성이 커졌다. 불법 사채 조직의 실태를 고발한 동아일보 히어로콘텐츠팀의 ‘트랩: 돈의 덫에 걸리다’ 시리즈 보도 이후 정부와 국회가 종합대책 추진을 본격화한 것이다.

spans.text: N. Korea pulls railway sleepers on Donghae Line
spans.gt_tgt: 北, 남북철도 아예 못쓰게 동해선 침목 뽑았다

spans.text: It has been confirmed that North Korea has recently begun dismantling the 'Donghae Line' railway sleepers leading to Mt. Kumgang. This railway was initially connected following the North-South Joint Declaration on June 15, 2000, and the actual tracks were laid in 2006 during the Roh Moo-hyun administration. In 2007, a test run was conducted from North Korea's Kumgangsan Station to Jejin Station, the northernmost station in South Korea. North Korea, which had previously implemented blockade measures such as planting mines on the Gyeongui Line and Donghae Line land routes, now appears to be demolishing the railway entirely, signaling its intention to sever inter-Korean relations. North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong Un declared the severance of inter-Korean relations at the end of last year. The South Korean government believes that North Korea may soon demolish the 'Gyeongui Line' railway passing through the Kaesong Industrial Complex and officially announce this externally.
spans.gt_tgt: 북한이 최근 금강산으로 이어지는 ‘동해선’ 철로 철거에 나선 것으로 확인됐다. 이 철로는 2000년 6·15 남북공동선언을 계기로 연결돼 노무현 정부 당시인 2006년 실제 철로가 놓였다. 2007년에는 북한 금강산역에서 남한 최북단 역사인 제진역까지 한 차례 시범 운행까지 이뤄진 바 있다. 앞서 경의선·동해선 육상 도로에 지뢰를 매설하는 등 봉쇄 조치에 나선 북한이 이번에 철로까지 철거하기로 한 건 남북 관계를 완전히 단절하겠단 의도가 반영된 것이다. 김정은 북한 국무위원장은 지난해 말 남북 관계 단절을 선언한 바 있다. 정부는 조만간 북한이 개성공단을 지나는 ‘경의선’ 철로 철거까지 나선 뒤 이를 대외적으로 공식화할 가능성도 있는 것으로 보고 있다.

spans.text: The legislative efforts of the National Assembly have encountered a setback, particularly in the passage of bills integral to the nation’s economy and people's livelihoods. Notably, the proposed legislation seeking a two-year postponement of the enforcement of the Serious Accidents Punishment Act for small-scale enterprises employing fewer than 50 individuals has met an impasse. spans.text: Dawn delivery becomes a function of quality of life
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: Kim Jeong-hoon (28), an office worker who moved from Gwangju City to Hampyeong County in South Jeolla Province in July this year along with his new job, expressed the inconvenience of being unable to utilize dawn delivery, surpassing his expectations. Due to early morning commutes and returning home after 8 or 9 p.m., he has no time to shop separately. Ordering groceries online is necessary, but the freshness diminishes if delivered during the day. Dawn delivery, providing meat and vegetables in the early morning, has become essential. However, living in an area without dawn delivery, he stopped cooking, eventually relying on dining out or instant products. spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: The number of elementary and middle school students in Seoul in 2035 will be about half of what it is today, according to the first analysis of its kind by the Seoul Metropolitan Office of Education. spans.text: Even with the stock market continuously weakening, the scale of debt financing among investors is hitting a record yearly high day after day. spans.text: 'Urbanization effect on temperature rises,' says a study

spans.text: The Korea Meteorological Administration and the National Institute of Meteorological Sciences announced on Wednesday their findings of the urbanization effect on temperature rise, using observation data from a total of 30 places from 1973 to 2020. The study included eight large cities (population of one million or more), eight small and medium-sized cities (population of 300,000 or more), and 14 non-cities (population of around 100,000). The analysis shows that the number of heat wave days and the average temperature in small- and medium-sized cities, such as Cheongju in North Chungcheong Province and Gumi in North Gyeongsang Province, increased more than in large cities, such as Seoul, Busan, and Daegu.

spans.text: It has been confirmed that North Korea fired several long-range cruise missiles, presumed to be the North Korean version of the Tomahawk, into the Yellow Sea early Saturday morning. This came two days after the regime menacingly argued that the arrival of the Ohio-class nuclear ballistic missile submarine USS Kentucky (SSBN-773) in Busan qualifies it to deploy nuclear arms. Military authorities analyzed that it carried out a surprise nuclear provocation unexpectedly in the wee hours just three days after launching two SRBMs, highly assumed to be the North Korean version of the Iskander (KN-23), into the East Sea early on Wednesday morning. South Korea and the United States also keep a close eye on the regime as it has shown signs of holding a large-scale military parade on July 27 that marks the signing of the Korean Armistice Agreement, which has been arbitrarily proclaimed and celebrated as Victory Day in North Korea.

spans.text: N. Korea to launch its first military reconnaissance satellite
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: North Korea officially notified to the Japanese Coast Guard on Monday that it would launch its first military reconnaissance satellite between midnight May 31 and midnight June 11. This would be in 13 days since North Korean leader Kim Jong Un approved the ‘Next Action Plan’ for satellite launch on May 16 after announcing the completion of the satellite last month. North Korea’s satellite launch in seven years since February 2016 when the Kwangmyongsong 4 launched in February 2016 is imminent. An analysis by The Dong-A Ilbo on the maritime threat zone that North Korea notified to Japan showed that the carrier of the satellite is likely to be launched on Wednesday, fly over the West Sea and land in the sea east of the Philippines.
spans.gt_tgt: 북한이 31일 0시부터 6월 11일 0시 사이에 군사 정찰위성 1호기를 발사하겠다고 일본 해상보안청에 29일 공식 통보했다. 지난달 정찰위성 1호기 완성 발표에 이어 이달 16일 김정은 국무위원장이 위성 발사를 위한 ‘차후 행동계획’을 승인한 지 13일 만이다. 2016년 2월 ‘광명성 4호’ 발사 이후 7년 만의 북한의 위성 발사가 ‘초읽기’에 들어갔다. 북한이 일본에 통보한 ‘해상 위협구역’을 동아일보가 분석한 결과 위성을 실은 운반체는 이르면 31일 발사된 뒤 서해상을 따라 비행해 필리핀 동쪽 해상에 떨어질 것으로 예상된다.

spans.text: Estimates forecast that, if Korea's National Pension Service (NPS) continues to manage the pension funds the same way as now, the payouts will dry up by 2055. spans.text: Korea’s exports, the nation’s engine of growth, have declined for two consecutive months due to a global economic slowdown and energy price spike, compounded by a nationwide strike of unionized cargo truckers. spans.text: Korea and China to begin 1.5-track dialogue in next spring
spans.gt_tgt: 한중, 1.5 트랙 대화 내년 봄 이전 시작 합의…“대중관계 재설정”
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: South Korea and China have allegedly agreed to begin the ‘1.5-track’ dialogue centering on economy and trade before spring next year at the latest and are having detailed discussions. The two nations also decided to launch a high-level economic cooperation body on which the discussions are already underway. Amid its recent all-out efforts for an economic rebound, the government reportedly concluded that enhancing the relations with China, the country’s biggest export market, is key to revitalizing the economy. Cooperation with China has become ever more important for the Korean government to rein in North Korea, which is about to undergo its seventh nuclear test. With President Xi Jinping having secured his third term as the Chinese leader, some say that China would need Korea as an ally to keep it from leaning heavily toward the U.S. This naturally opens up a chance for the two countries to broaden the scope of exchanges.
spans.gt_tgt: 한국과 중국이 경제통상 분야가 중심이 된 ‘1.5트랙’ 대화를 늦어도 내년 봄 이전에 시작하기로 하고 세부 논의를 진행 중인 것으로 알려졌다. 양국은 고위급 경제협력체도 가동하기로 하고 사전 논의에 착수했다. 정부는 최근 경제 활성화에 총력을 집중하는 가운데 최대 수출 시장인 중국과의 관계 강화가 이에 필수적이란 판단을 내린 것으로 전해졌다. 또 7차 핵실험이 임박한 북한을 압박하기 위해서라도 대중(對中) 협력 필요성은 커진 상황. 중국 역시 시진핑(習近平) 국가주석이 3연임을 확정한 가운데 한국이 미국에 지나치게 치우치지 않도록 우군으로 확보할 필요성이 커지면서 자연스럽게 한중 간 교류의 폭을 넓힐 수 있는 공간이 열렸다는 분석이 나온다.

spans.text: The World Bank released a report warning of a global economic recession. Inventories of Korea's local companies reached a record high in 26 years, sending warning signals. Fear of a possible global economic downturn is spreading both locally and overseas.

spans.text: Consumer prices rise over 6% for two months running
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: The inflation rate of consumer goods hovered at 6.3 percent last month, exceeding the mark of 6 percent for two months in a row to reach a 24-year high. Notably, the prices of eating out rose 8.4 percent from last year on the back of the surge in international crop prices, shooting to a record high in about 30 years. Along with vegetable whose prices have jumped over 20 percent, Korea’s dining prices are nearing the red line.
spans.gt_tgt: 지난달 소비자물가 상승률이 6.3%로 두 달 연속 6%대 고공행진을 이어가며 24년 만에 최고치를 기록했다. 특히 외식 물가는 국제 곡물가격 상승 여파로 전년보다 8.4% 오르며 약 30년 만에 가장 많이 올랐다. 20% 넘게 가격이 급등한 채소류와 더불어 ‘밥상 물가’에 빨간불이 켜졌다.

spans.text: North Korea might be arranging another nuclear test, as suggested by a series of photographs capturing the rebuilding of tunnels at the Punggye-ri nuclear test site. spans.text: The global stock of nuclear weapons, which has been continuously curbed since the end of the Cold War, is expected to grow again over the next decade. spans.text: Further increase interest rates expected amid record high oil prices

spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: Oil prices on average have spiked to a new record high both in South Korea and the United States. spans.text: Signs have been witnessed that North Korea is attempting to scale up the Yongbyon Nuclear Science and Weapons Research Center. spans.text: The Hwawon-14-type ICBM-class missile, which North Korea fired in a surprise move Friday night, has an estimated maximum target range of more than 10,000 kilometers. This is because the maximum flying distance of a ballistic missile is generally estimated to be about three times the missile’s maximum altitude. The maximum flying altitude of the Hwasong-14 type missile, which has been fired this time, is calculated at 3,724.9 kilometers. The missile flew about 900 kilometers higher this time than that of the first provocation (maximum flying attitude of 2,802 kilometers) on July 4. The Hwasong-14 type missiles were fired at high angles both in the first and second rounds. If the missile had been fired at a normal angle of 30 to 45 degrees, the maximum range of the missile used in the first provocation would be 8,000 kilometers. The South Korean military is paying attention to the fact that the maximum range increased by more than 2,000 kilometers in the second provocation, which came only about 20 days after the first.

spans.text: Europe enjoys golden age of female politicians
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: Europe is now in the golden age of female politicians. From German Chancellor Angela Merkel, British Prime Minister Theresa May to female two tops, not a few opposition parties have appointed female politicians as their leaders. Some 32 percent of the UK’s politicians are female, which brings the nation to be ranked at 46th in the world. European nations are rapidly moving to strike a balance of male and female lawmakers at 50 to 50. Female lawmakers have already accounted for more than 40 percent in Sweden, Finland, Iceland and Spain, while latter half of 30 percent women are working as politician in countries such as Norway, Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands and Germany. The U.S. with congresswomen at 19.1 percent is ranked at 101 in the world.
spans.gt_tgt: 1913년 6월 8일 국왕 조지 5세의 경주마가 런던 인근 엡섬다운스 더비(경마) 결승점을 향해 질주하던 순간, 여성 참정운동가 한 명이 말을 향해 몸을 던졌다. 사흘 뒤 사망한 에밀리 데이비슨은 ‘여성들은 비논리적이고 변덕스러워 투표의 책임을 질 수 없다’는 해괴망측한 남성들의 논리를 향해 몸을 던진 것이었다. 옥스퍼드대 영문과 출신 엘리트 여성의 행동에 놀란 남성들은 5년 뒤(1918년) 여성의 참정권을 허용했다.

spans.text: With a week to go before the presidential election, presidential candidates and key figures of political parties are saying tough words. spans.text: Controversy is flaring up anew over "Song Min-soon's memoir" ahead of the May 9 presidential election. Former Foreign Affairs and Trade Minister Song Min-soon, who is now president of the University of North Korean Studies, disclosed on Friday a document related to his claim in his memoir suggesting that Minjoo Party presidential candidate Moon Jae-in, who had served as presidential chief of staff for the late President Roh Moo-hyun, had instructed that “First, let’s check (North Korea’s response) through the inter-Korean (communication) channel” before South Korea voted on a U.N. resolution on North Korea’s human rights. Song’s memoir entitled “The Iceberg is Moving” was published in October last year. Moon is strongly refuting Song’s claim, saying that this is a second Bukpung (literally meaning winds from North Korea) plot meant to influence election by taking advantage of North Korea, and a malign accusation of me being pro-North Korean.” National security issues are thus effectively emerging as a core concern of the upcoming presidential election, as outcry over Song’s memoir has also surfaced on top of the controversy over the North as "the main enemy (of the South).”

spans.text: What was Pres. Park doing when ferry Sewol was sinking?

spans.text: There are media reports claiming that President Park Geun-hye spent more than 90 minutes to get her hair done by a famous hairdresser on the day of the fatal Sewol ferry incident two years ago. A television news program reported that the hairdresser did the president’s hair in the morning but had to redo it in the afternoon to make the president’s hair look less tidy for her visit to the Central Disaster and Safety Countermeasures Headquarters. The presidential office Cheong Wa Dae explained that two hairdressers stayed there for about one hour form 3:20 p.m. on the day and took 20 minutes to take care of the president’s hair. Many citizens, particularly those with children, are angry about the president spending time getting her hair done while a ferry carrying more than 300 high school students was sinking, whether it took 90 minutes or 20 minutes for the hairdo.
spans.gt_tgt: 2년 전 세월호 참사 당일에 박근혜 대통령이 서울 강남의 유명 미용사를 청와대로 불러 ‘올림머리’를 하느라 90분 이상 걸렸다는 보도가 나왔다. 해당 미용사는 아침에 대통령의 머리를 만졌으나 오후 민방위복을 입고 중앙재난안전대책본부에 가는 상황에 맞춰 일부러 머리를 부스스하게 다시 손질했다는 방송보도도 있다. 청와대는 “당일 미용사 2명이 오후 3시 20분경부터 1시간 정도 청와대에 머물렀고 머리 손질에 걸린 시간은 20분”이라고 해명했다. 많은 국민, 특히 자식가진 부모들은 대통령이 올림머리를 하는 데 90분이 걸렸든, 20분이 걸렸든 300명 넘는 아이들이 침몰하는 순간에 머리손질을 할 여유가 있느냐고 분노하고 있다.

spans.text: Nuclear-powered submarines are holding the limelight as countermeasure against the threat from North Korea’s Submarine Launched Ballistic Missiles (SLBM) for their performance in covertness and striking power that overshadows conventional (diesel-powered) submarines. Conventional models are more likely to be detected by enemy in the process of emerging above the surface of the waters to replenish oxygen for their storage batteries. For proper operation, conventional submarines need to charge their batteries two or three times a day, each for one to two hours, which makes it highly likely for them to be seen and struck by anti-submarine forces such as the maritime operation helicopter. While there are more enhanced diesel-powered submarines, which generate oxygen with fuel cells, even with those, under-water operation can only last a maximum two hours.
spans.gt_tgt: 북한 잠수함발사탄도미사일(SLBM)에 대한 대응책으로 핵추진잠수함(핵잠)이 주목받는 이유는 은밀성과 공격력 면에서 재래식잠수함(디젤 추진)을 압도하기 때문이다. 재래식잠수함은 축전지 충전용 산소 공급을 위해 수면으로 부상하는 과정에서 적에게 발각될 위험이 높다. 재래식잠수함의 경우 하루에 2, 3번, 1회에 1∼2시간 충전을 해야 정상적인 작전이 가능한데, 이때 적의 해상작전헬기 등 대잠수함 전력에 발각돼 타격당할 가능성이 크다. 연료전지로 산소를 자체 생산하는 개량형 디젤잠수함 역시 물속에서 조용히 감시 작전만을 수행할 경우에도 수중 임무를 지속할 수 있는 최대 시간이 2주가량에 불과하다.

spans.text: N. Korea makes rapid progress in SLBM development
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: Despite North Korea’s evolving missile capabilities, South Korea has no effective measures to deal with it. Although North Korea is in a countdown to deploying a submarine-launched ballistic missile (SLBM) with a range of 2,000 kilometers, the South is mired in controversies over the planned deployment of the Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD) anti-missile system, raising concerns over a vacuum in defense against the North Korean nuclear capabilities. Experts say that as the North’s SLBMs are hard to intercept even with the THAAD system, the South could be held a nuclear hostage without extraordinary measures. Critics also say that the South Korean military wasted the “golden time” for seeking the optimal defense by underestimating the North’s SLBM development.
spans.gt_tgt: 북한의 미사일 능력은 진화하는데도 마땅한 대응책이 없다. 북한의 사거리 2000km급 잠수함발사탄도미사일(SLBM) 실전 배치가 ‘초읽기’에 돌입했지만 한국은 사드(THAAD·고고도미사일방어체계)의 배치 논란에 빠지면서 북핵 방어 공백 우려가 커지고 있다. 북한의 SLBM은 사드로도 요격이 힘들어 특단의 대책이 마련되지 않으면 북한의 ‘핵 인질’로 전락할 것이라는 지적이 나온다. 군 당국이 북한의 SLBM 개발 수준을 과소평가해 최적의 방어수단 강구를 위한 ‘골든타임’을 허비했다는 비판도 제기되고 있다.

spans.text: Mokdong Redevelopment Bids Turn to Condition Competition
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: The landscape of the Mokdong New Town reconstruction project, the largest redevelopment initiative in southwestern Seoul, is shifting. Instead of rushing to select construction companies before rising costs—previously dubbed a “speed war”—a “condition competition” is emerging, where developers vie to offer the best financial support and project terms. Residents are increasingly vocal, stating, “We must secure better conditions than the 6th district, which recently selected a contractor,” and a consensus is forming that “even if it takes a few more months, a competitive bidding process is necessary.” Beyond guaranteeing high-end apartment brands, negotiations now include relocation expense financing, fixed construction costs, inflation cost-sharing, and whether to delay sales until after construction.

spans.text: Humanity Tinkers With Earth's Natural Defenses
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: In September 1859, a massive storm from the Sun engulfed Earth. A solar storm is a phenomenon where electrically charged particles and magnetic fields emitted by the Sun disrupt the space environment around Earth. The Carrington Event, as the storm was called, illuminated auroras even in non-polar regions and paralyzed telegraph systems. Electrocutions and fires also occurred. If such a solar storm were to strike today, the damage would be incomparably greater. This is because satellites, communication networks, and power grids could all be simultaneously disrupted. Power grid damage alone is estimated to reach 3.4 trillion dollars (approximately 5,170 trillion Korean won).
spans.gt_tgt: 1859년 9월, 태양에서 날아온 거대한 폭풍이 지구를 덮쳤다. 태양폭풍은 태양이 내뿜은 전기 입자와 자기장이 지구 주변 우주 환경을 뒤흔드는 현상이다. ‘캐링턴 사건’으로 불리는 당시 태양폭풍은 극지방이 아닌 곳에서도 오로라를 밝히고, 전보 시스템을 마비시켰다. 감전, 화재 사고도 났다. 이런 태양폭풍이 오늘날 다시 닥치면 피해는 비교할 수 없을 만큼 커진다. 위성과 통신망, 전력망이 동시에 흔들릴 수 있기 때문이다. 전력망 피해만 최대 3조4000억달러(약 5170조원)에 달할 것으로 추산된다.

spans.text: Korean Abbreviation Debate Reflects Generational Divide
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: In truth, every word we use began as a compression, and we’ve created countless abbreviations since. We shortened countless plants with roots and leaves to ‘namu’ (tree), and after adopting Chinese characters, we compressed ‘namu-dari’ (wooden bridge) to ‘mokgyo.’ Leveraging the characteristics of logograms, we efficiently condensed ‘Jeon-guk Gyeongje-in Yeonhap-hoi’ (National Economic Persons Federation) to ‘Jeon-gyeong-nyeon.’ We quickly referenced specific proper nouns like ‘E-dae’ (Ewha Womans University) and ‘Ju-gong’ (Korea Land and Housing Corporation), and conveniently described our lives with terms like ‘jip-bap’ (home-cooked meals), ‘soopsekwon’ (forest proximity zone), and ‘kku-an-kku’ (casually styled).
spans.gt_tgt: ‘중요한 것은 꺾이지 않는 마음’은 감동을 불러일으켰지만 ‘중꺾마’는 줄임말에 대한 해묵은 논쟁에 기름을 부었다. 2022년 카타르 월드컵 16강 진출을 자축하며 우리 팀이 펼친 태극기 하단에는 누구나 이해할 수 있는 문구가 있었으나 남은 것은 ‘중꺾마’ 세 글자였다. 이 줄임말은 경기장을 넘어 학교로, 직장으로, 광고와 정치의 언어로 번져나갔다. 누군가는 웅혼한 기상을 읽었고, 누군가는 별걸 다 줄인다며 혀를 찼다. 줄임말을 향한 이 엇갈린 감정은 지금도 월드컵 열기 못지않게 뜨겁다.

spans.gt_tgt: 페트병 제작, 폐플라스틱 30% 써야… 규제 맞추려 해외 쓰레기 수입할 판
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: Starting from 2030, colorless polyethylene terephthalate (PET) bottles used for water or beverages must contain at least 30% recycled material. Currently regulated to use over 10% recycled material, the government plans to raise this to 30% over four years. Amid unstable supply of petroleum and naphtha—key plastic raw materials—due to the fallout from the Middle East war, the government has turned to recycled plastic as an alternative. Critics argue, “As recycled materials, which cost 20–30% more to produce, become more valuable, they could drive inflation.”
spans.gt_tgt: 오는 2030년부터 물이나 음료를 담는 무색 페트(PET)병에 재생 원료가 30% 이상 들어가야 한다. 현재 10% 이상 재생 원료를 쓰도록 규제 중인데 이를 4년간 30%까지 높이겠다는 것이 정부 계획이다. 중동 전쟁 여파로 플라스틱 원료인 석유와 나프타 수급이 불안정해지자, 정부가 ‘재활용 플라스틱’인 재생 원료를 대안으로 꺼낸 것이다. 이를 두고 “생산 단가가 20~30% 더 높은 재생 원료가 ‘귀한 몸’이 되면서 물가 상승을 견인할 수 있다”는 지적이 나온다.

spans.text: Democratic Party's Preferential Vote Faces Constitutional Challenge
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: The Democratic Party of Korea’s National Convention Preparatory Committee (Junchunwi) decided on July 7 to adopt a preferential voting system instead of a runoff vote for the party leadership election. Former Representative Jung Chung-rae and the pro-Cheong faction protested the next day, July 8, stating, “The party constitution and regulations stipulate the implementation of a runoff vote,” and argued that the preferential vote violates these rules. Meanwhile, former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok said, “Once a rule is set, it is better to respect it regardless of its advantages or disadvantages.” The committee reportedly tentatively concluded that the preferential vote does not violate the party constitution and regulations. The leadership is expected to reach a final decision on the election method as early as July 9.
spans.gt_tgt: 더불어민주당 전당대회준비위원회(전준위)가 지난 7일 당대표 선거 방식을 ‘결선투표’가 아닌 ‘선호투표’로 결정하자 정청래 전 대표와 친청계는 하루 뒤인 8일 “당헌·당규는 결선투표 실시를 규정하고 있다”며 선호투표는 당헌·당규 위반이라고 반발했다. 반면 김민석 전 국무총리는 “한번 룰이 정해지면 유불리를 떠나 그대로 존중하는 게 좋다”고 했다. 전준위는 이날 선호투표가 당헌·당규 위반이 아니라고 잠정적으로 결론 내린 것으로 알려졌다. 지도부는 이르면 9일 선거 방식에 관해 결론을 내릴 예정이다.

spans.gt_tgt: 아시아나와 합병 후 '서열 갈등'… 대한항공 조종사노조 파업 위기
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: As Korean Air and Asiana Airlines prepare for their integration by the end of this year, the Korean Air Pilots’ labor union has applied for labor dispute mediation, beginning the process toward a strike. If mediation fails, the union will secure the right to dispute for the first time in 10 years. A unique criterion in the aviation industry, known as “seniority (ranking),” determines the order of pilot promotions to captain. The union opposes the management’s plan to integrate the seniority rankings of pilots from both Korean Air and Asiana after the merger, which has become the central issue. The union also claims that this seniority issue falls under the scope of labor disputes as defined by the Yellow Envelop Act (revised Labor Union Act), drawing significant attention from the industry.
spans.gt_tgt: 올해 말 대한항공·아시아나항공 통합을 앞두고 대한항공 조종사노조가 노동쟁의 조정을 신청하면서 파업 절차를 밟기 시작했다. 조정이 성립되지 않으면 노조는 10년만에 쟁의권을 확보한다. 항공업계에는 기장 승격 순서를 정하는 ‘시니어리티(서열)’란 독특한 기준이 있는데, 사측이 통합 대한항공 출범 후 아시아나항공 출신 기장과 서열을 통합해 운영하겠다고 한 것에 노조가 반대하고 있는 게 쟁점이다. 특히 노조는 이 서열 문제가 노란봉투법(개정 노동조합법)이 정하는 노동 쟁의 대상이라고도 주장하고 있어, 업계의 관심이 쏠린다.

spans.text: As the integration of Korean Air and Asiana Airlines approaches by the end of this year, the Korean Air Pilots’ Union has applied for labor dispute mediation with the Seoul Regional Labor Commission, marking the first such move in about a decade. spans.text: Progressives Split, Conservatives Unify in Superintendent Elections
spans.gt_tgt: 교육감 선거, 이젠 진보 쪼개지고 보수 단일화
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: The candidate registration for the June 3 local elections concluded on the 15th, with regions where progressive candidates failed to unify and multiple candidates emerged in superintendent elections continuously appearing. In superintendent elections, where political party intervention is prohibited, unification within ideological blocs is considered a key strategy for winning. Historically, conservatives tended to split while progressives successfully unified, securing superintendent positions. Across 17 electoral districts, the number of progressive superintendents was six in 2010, increased to 14 in 2018 through the "unification strategy," and exceeded half with nine in the last election. However, this year, the past formula has broken down, with progressives splitting in a new trend. This is attributed to progressive candidates increasing their participation, judging that their chances of winning are high due to the ruling party’s elevated approval rating.
spans.gt_tgt: 6·3 지방선거 후보자 등록이 15일 마감한 가운데, 교육감 선거에서 진보 후보들이 단일화에 실패하며 후보가 난립한 지역이 잇따라 나오고 있다. 정당 개입이 금지된 교육감 선거에선 진영 내 단일화가 당선의 핵심 전략으로 꼽힌다. 그간 대체로 보수는 분열하고 진보는 단일화에 성공해 교육감 자리를 차지했었다. 총 17개 선거구에서 진보 교육감은 2010년 6명이었는데, ‘단일화 전략’으로 2018년 14명으로 늘었고 지난 선거에서도 9명으로 과반이 넘었다. 그런데 올해는 이런 과거 공식이 깨지고 진보가 분열하는 새로운 양상이 나타나고 있는 것이다. 여당 지지율이 높은 상황에서 교육감도 진보 진영의 당선 가능성이 높다는 판단에 선거에 완주하려는 진보 후보들이 늘어난 것으로 풀이된다.

spans.text: Unchangeable Online Resident Number Sparks Validity Period Demand
spans.gt_tgt: 털려도 변경 불가 '온라인 주민번호'… "유효기간제 도입 시급"
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: From May to June this year, large-scale leaks of CI (Connecting Information, also known as an "online resident registration number") occurred at Tving, BGF Networks (CU convenience store parcel service), and Woori Bank. CI is a unique identifier linked to resident registration numbers and used for online identity verification. Once issued, it is virtually impossible to change, raising concerns about potential secondary damage. The cybersecurity industry noted, “The same CI is used for simple authentication services like Naver and Kakao, as well as logins for various online services,” adding, “The fact that such critical information has been stolen by hackers and cannot be changed is a major security vulnerability.”
spans.gt_tgt: 지난 5~6월 티빙·BGF네트웍스(CU 편의점 택배)·우리은행에서 잇따라 CI(연계번호, 일명 ‘온라인 주민번호’)가 대규모로 유출됐다. CI는 주민등록번호와 연계된 고유의 식별값으로 온라인에서 본인 인증에 사용되고 있는데, 한 번 발급되면 사실상 변경이 불가능해 2차 피해 발생 가능성에 대한 우려가 커지고 있다. 정보 보안 업계에선 “네이버·카카오 등 간편 인증이나 여러 온라인 서비스에 로그인할 때 동일한 CI가 활용되고 있다”면서 “이렇게 중요한 정보가 해커들에게 털리고 있는데 변경이 불가능하다는 것은 보안의 중대한 취약점”이라고 말했다.

spans.text: The Seoul Central District Prosecutors’ Office indicted B without detention on charges of defrauding A, who has borderline intellectual disabilities, of 6,620,000 Korean won on the 26th of last month. It also requested the court to initiate a “limited guardianship” system, appointing A’s daughter as a guardian. Limited guardianship is a system where a guardian is appointed to manage the property of adults with insufficient cognitive abilities. For financial transactions exceeding a court-specified amount, the guardian’s consent is required, preventing additional fraud. The prosecution not only clarified the suspect’s criminal charges but also separately took civil measures to protect the victim.
spans.gt_tgt: 서울중앙지검은 지난달 26일 경계선 지적장애를 가진 A씨에게 662만원의 사기 피해를 입힌 B씨를 불구속 기소하는 한편 A씨의 딸을 후견인으로 하는 ‘한정후견 개시’ 심판도 법원에 청구했다. 한정후견이란 인지 능력이 부족한 성인의 재산 관리 등을 대신할 사람을 선임하는 제도다. 법원이 지정한 일정 금액 이상의 금전 거래를 하려면 후견인의 동의가 필요해 추가적인 사기 피해를 예방할 수 있다. 검찰이 사기 피의자의 범죄 혐의를 밝히는 한편 피해자 보호를 위한 민법상 조치도 별도로 취한 것이다.

spans.text: Seoul E-Cigarette Vending Machines Fail Fake ID Tests
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: On the afternoon of the 2nd, a fake resident registration card featuring the cartoon character “Ddol” was inserted into an e-cigarette vending machine installed at a subway station in Jung-gu, Seoul. After pressing the adult verification button, the machine immediately announced, “Adult verification has been completed.” Upon completing the payment, the machine dispensed a liquid-type e-cigarette. The phrase “Identity theft remains a lifelong criminal record” printed on the machine seemed meaningless in the situation. This fake ID was created by Seoul City to investigate the adult verification systems of e-cigarette vending machines. It was a plastic plate the same size as a resident registration card, with Ddol’s image attached. The name was listed as “Ddol,” the date of birth as “April 22, 1983,” and the address as “Ddol’s Street, Wonmi-gu, Bucheon City.” Despite being clearly a fake ID, it passed the adult verification of the vending machine.

spans.text: Ministry Reviews Discontinuation of Mobile Verification Service Over AI Forgeries
spans.gt_tgt: 정부, 주민등록증 모바일 확인서비스 폐지 검토
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: The Ministry of the Interior and Safety announced on the 28th that it is reviewing the discontinuation of the **'Resident Registration Card Mobile Verification Service'**, four years after its introduction in 2022. This decision follows recent criticism over the spread of cases where AI (artificial intelligence) is being used to forge and misuse service screens. The Resident Registration Card Mobile Verification Service is widely used in convenience stores, bars, and other establishments for age verification purposes. Users register their resident registration cards in government online administrative services such as the **'Gov24'** app and display them when needed. Currently, the service has approximately **8.7 million users**. It differs from the **'Mobile Resident Registration Card'** introduced in 2024, which applies blockchain technology and can be used like a physical ID at government offices and banks. In contrast, the Resident Registration Card Mobile Verification Service has lower security levels and is primarily used in daily life.
spans.gt_tgt: 행정안전부가 ‘주민등록증 모바일 확인 서비스’ 폐지를 검토하고 있다고 28일 밝혔다. 2022년 도입한 지 4년 만이다. 최근 AI(인공지능)로 서비스 화면을 위조·악용하는 사례가 확산하고 있다는 지적이 나와서다. 주민등록증 모바일 확인 서비스는 편의점, 주점 등에서 성인 확인 용도로 많이 쓰인다. 정부의 온라인 행정 서비스인 ‘정부24’ 앱 등에 주민등록증을 등록해 놓고 필요할 때 꺼내 보여주는 방식이다. 현재 이용자는 약 870만명이다. 2024년 도입한 ‘모바일 주민등록증’과 다르다. 모바일 주민등록증은 블록체인 기술을 적용해 관공서, 은행 등에서 실물 신분증처럼 쓸 수 있지만 주민등록증 모바일 확인 서비스는 보안 수준이 낮아 일상생활에서 주로 쓴다.

spans.text: Economic disparities among members of society are inevitable during the process of national economic growth. While it may not be possible to completely eliminate these gaps, it is the role of politics to mitigate them. However, during the alternation of power between conservative (right-wing) and progressive (left-wing) factions, politics has instead used these disparities as "fuel" to amplify anger and deepen conflicts. Lee Bo-mi, a researcher at Seoul National University’s Korean Political Research Institute, said, “Progressives incited awareness of inequality under the banner of a ‘fair society,’ while conservatives, despite advocating for ‘competent conservatism,’ proved ineffective in addressing the gaps.”

spans.text: FDA Approves RAS-Targeting Drug That Doubles Pancreatic Cancer Survival
spans.gt_tgt: 美 FDA, '난공불락' 췌장암 먹는 신약 승인… 생존 기간 2배로

spans.text: A cancer drug that targets a previously "undruggable" protein and nearly doubles the survival period of patients with metastatic pancreatic cancer has received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA). spans.text: On June 26, 2024, the Russian satellite ‘Resurs-P1,’ which had completed its mission and was orbiting Earth, suddenly disintegrated. Hundreds of fragments scattered, some of which headed toward the nearby International Space Station (ISS). Traveling at speeds exceeding thousands to tens of thousands of kilometers per hour—faster than bullets—the debris could have completely destroyed the ISS upon impact. NASA immediately issued an emergency alert to the ISS astronauts, instructing them to evacuate to the Earth Return Vehicle. The astronauts waited in fear for over an hour until the debris passed the ISS’s orbit.
spans.gt_tgt: 2024년 6월 26일, 임무를 마치고 지구 궤도를 돌던 러시아 위성 ‘레수르스-P1’이 갑자기 산산조각 났다. 수백 개의 파편이 흩어지더니, 그중 일부가 인근의 국제우주정거장(ISS)을 향했다. 이 파편들의 속도는 총알보다 빠른 시속 수천~수만㎞. 부딪히면 ISS를 완전히 파괴할 수도 있는 무시무시한 속도다. 미 항공우주국(NASA)은 즉각 ISS의 우주인들에게 비상을 걸어 “지구 귀환용 우주선으로 피신하라”고 지시했다. 우주인들은 파편들이 ISS 궤도를 지나쳐 사라질 때까지 1시간 이상 공포에 떨며 대기해야 했다.

spans.text: Loans that banks have extended to businesses and households, which have become difficult to recover, have nearly reached 19 trillion Korean won. spans.text: AI Homogenizes Writing Styles, Outperforms Humans in Persuasion

spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: When writing or speaking, people tend to use different words they favor. Some refer to close friends as "best friend" (베프), while others may prefer "jeolchin, close friend" (절친), "jjinchi, true friend" (찐친), or "bongu, friend" (붕우), among others. But what if all such vocabulary were eliminated and only one term remained? In George Orwell’s novel *1984*, the ruling Big Brother creates "Newspeak" and systematically removes existing diverse vocabulary. For example, the word "good" is retained while "bad" is eliminated, replaced by "ungood" using the same prefix. The intent is to eradicate linguistic diversity, enforce mechanical uniformity, narrow the scope of thought, and ensure compliance with authoritarian control.
spans.gt_tgt: 글을 쓰거나 말을 할 때 사람마다 즐겨 쓰는 단어가 다르다. 친한 친구를 가리키는 말로 ‘베프’를 쓰는 이가 있는가 하면, ‘절친(切親)’ ‘찐친’ ‘붕우(朋友)’ 등 선호가 다를 수 있다. 그런데 이런 어휘를 모두 없애고 하나만 쓰게 한다면 어떻게 될까. 조지 오웰의 소설 ‘1984’에는 빅브라더가 지배하는 사회에서 ‘신어(Newspeak)’를 만들고, 기존의 다양한 어휘를 제거해 간다. 예컨대 ‘좋은(good)’이라는 단어는 살리고 ‘나쁜(bad)’은 없애는 것이다. 대신 동일한 접두어를 붙여 ‘안좋은(ungood)’으로 반대말을 만드는 식이다. 어휘의 다양성을 말살하고 기계적으로 획일화해 사고의 폭을 좁히고, 권력의 통제에 순응하도록 한다는 취지다.

spans.text: Democratic Party Ends Prosecution Authority, Victims Face Costs
spans.gt_tgt: 경찰이 범죄 증거 놓치면 그걸로 끝… 피해자는 변호사비 '눈덩이'
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: The Democratic Party of Korea abolished the prosecution’s supplementary investigation authority on the 31st by processing a revised Criminal Procedure Act at the National Assembly’s plenary session. Once the prosecution office is dissolved and transitions to an indictment agency in October, the police will take charge of investigating crimes affecting people’s livelihoods. Prosecutors will determine whether to indict based solely on records sent by the police to the indictment agency. Legal circles worry that victims may bear the burden of correcting insufficient police investigations, which was previously the prosecution’s role to punish criminals and protect victims. There are also forecasts that case processing will be delayed and legal costs will rise.
spans.gt_tgt: 더불어민주당이 31일 형사소송법 개정안을 국회 본회의에서 처리하면서 검사의 보완수사권이 폐지됐다. 오는 10월 검찰청이 폐지되고 공소청으로 전환되면 경찰이 민생 범죄 수사를 전담한다. 검사는 경찰이 공소청으로 보낸 기록만 보고 기소 여부를 판단한다. 법조계에선 미진한 경찰 수사를 바로잡아 범죄자를 처벌하고 피해자 보호를 주된 임무로 하는 검사의 역할을 피해자 스스로 떠안게 될 가능성이 크다고 우려한다. 또 사건 처리가 지연되고 법률 비용이 증가할 것이라는 전망도 나온다.

spans.text: The Aviation and Railway Accident Investigation Board, which is investigating the Muan Jeju Air crash, confirmed on the 30th that it had identified circumstances suggesting the seats of the accident aircraft (manufactured by Boeing Company, USA) did not meet U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) regulations. At the moment of collision with a concrete embankment, the seats scattered and were torn out despite the impact being lower than the shock they were required to withstand under safety regulations. spans.text: Robots conquer household tasks with AI advances
spans.gt_tgt: 쿵후 발차기 하던 로봇, 앞치마 두르고 집안일 한다

spans.text: In the field of humanoid (human-shaped) robots, ‘home service robots’ are considered the most challenging area to develop. This is because each household has different furniture layouts, and variables such as floor obstacles, lighting changes, and pets add complexity. While robots can lift heavy objects or run quickly, they have struggled with delicate tasks like folding clothes or handling dishes and ingredients, which remain unresolved challenges. As a result, robots have primarily been deployed in standardized industrial settings like car factories or logistics warehouses, or showcased through martial arts stunts or flashy group performances.

spans.text: Starting from November, the ‘face’ of all alcohol bottles distributed domestically will change. This follows the Ministry of Health and Welfare’s guideline mandating strong alcohol warning messages and images on the front of all alcoholic beverages. spans.text: The Ministry of Education has been confirmed to have requested the presidential National Education Commission (NEC) to expand the portion of modern and contemporary history (from the opening of ports to the present) in middle school history textbooks, currently at 20 percent, to over 30 percent. The Ministry of Education claims, "The proportion of modern and contemporary history within middle school history subjects is insufficient, leading to inadequate education on modern and contemporary history before high school." However, the education sector points out, "Within the 5,000-year history of Korea, the historical value of modern and contemporary history, which spans only 150 years and is yet to be fully evaluated, should not be excessively expanded."

spans.text: DAY1 Company Prioritizes Failure Experience in Hiring
spans.gt_tgt: 이력서 대신 '실패 경험자' 채용 우대하는 스타트업

spans.text: “Experiencing a major failure means you’ve dared to take a significant challenge. We are a history of failures, and those failures stemmed from our attempts,” said Jang Joo-hoon, 32, head of the business division at NOA, a classical music content startup acquired by education company DAY1 Company. He found solace in the company’s “failure-preferred hiring” program description. During his time at POSTECH, Jang started a business with an award-winning idea from a startup competition: a solution to digitize the analog signal-command system used in the military. Reality, however, did not unfold as expected. Monetization proved difficult, and after spending one year out of three considering closure, he shut down the business. “The fact that I closed without giving it my all hurt my self-esteem more,” he said. “That’s why I couldn’t think about working at another company or starting anew.” After a period of wandering through delivery and warehouse jobs, he learned about DAY1’s “failure-preferred” program and applied. Post-hiring, he handled data organization and decision-making support in a struggling new business division, later moving to M&A tasks. In June of this year, he became the head of NOA’s business division.
spans.gt_tgt: “큰 실패를 했다는 것은 그만큼 크게 도전했다는 뜻입니다. 저희는 실패의 역사이고, 그 실패는 도전에서 기인했습니다.”

spans.text: Z.ai's GLM-5.2 Rises to Global Top 4, Outperforming Google
spans.gt_tgt: 제미나이 따라잡은 中 AI '즈푸'...중국 AI 자립 선봉장됐다

spans.text: Z.ai, Zhupu AI, an artificial intelligence (AI) model ‘GLM-5.2’ unveiled on the 13th has shaken the global tech industry. GLM-5.2 scored 51 points in evaluations by Artificial Analysis, a global AI performance assessment agency, ranking fourth worldwide behind Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5 (60 points), Operus 4.8 (56 points), and OpenAI’s GPT-5.5 (55 points). It outperformed all Google Gemini models. Guillermo Rauch, CEO of development platform Vercel, said, “I was genuinely impressed and shocked by GLM-5.2’s coding capabilities. This will change the game.” Investment bank Jefferies called GLM-5.2 “a milestone for Chinese AI.”
spans.gt_tgt: Z.ai(즈푸AI)가 지난 13일 공개한 인공지능(AI) 모델 ‘GLM-5.2′가 글로벌 테크 업계를 흔들어 놓고 있다. GLM-5.2는 글로벌 AI 성능 평가 기관인 아티피셜 애널리시스에서 앤스로픽의 클로드 페이블5(60점)와 오퍼스 4.8(56점), 오픈AI의 GPT-5.5(55점)에 이은 51점으로 세계 4위를 기록했다. 구글 제미나이의 모든 모델보다 높은 성능이다. 개발 플랫폼 버셀의 최고경영자(CEO) 기예르모 라우치는 “GLM-5.2의 코딩 능력에 진심으로 감탄했고 충격을 받았다”며 “이것은 판도를 바꿀 것”이라고 했다. 투자은행 제프리스는 GLM-5.2를 두고 “중국 AI의 이정표”라고 했다.

spans.text: The Democratic Party of Korea and the government are pushing to significantly relax labor regulations, including the weekly maximum 52-hour work system and restrictions on the employment of fixed-term and dispatched workers, in “mega special zones” such as the Honam Semiconductor Cluster. spans.text: An analysis released on the 2nd revealed that if the Special Prosecutor Bill for Manipulated Indictment Investigation, proposed by the Democratic Party of Korea in late April, passes the National Assembly as is, it would require 3.8 billion Korean won over two years. spans.text: Google, which sparked controversy over its "app toll tax" by charging up to 30% commission from global app developers, has agreed to pay £260 million (approximately 490 billion Korean won) in settlement to British developers. This decision comes as Google seeks to resolve a class-action lawsuit filed by UK app developers, who accused the company of abusing its dominance in the Android app distribution market to restrict competition and impose excessive fees. Although a 10-week main trial was scheduled, Google opted to settle by paying a quarter of the £1 billion-plus claim to end the dispute. Google did not admit to any monopolistic practices or illegality regarding in-app payments.

spans.text: The number of applications for land transaction permits for apartments in Seoul last month (June) decreased by nearly 40% compared to April, when the highest number of applications was recorded. Although transactions decreased, apartment prices soared. spans.text: While driving along National Route 7 past Yeongdeok, Gyeongbuk—a region renowned for its snow crabs—I suddenly stopped. I had spotted a massive ship anchored at one side of Jangsa Beach. The name “Jangsa Landing Operation Victory Memorial Hall” and the large inscription “Operation No. 174... Forgotten Heroes!” on the ship’s hull caught my eye. “What is the Jangsa Landing Operation?” I asked nearby campers relaxing in the area, but they remained silent. After touring the memorial hall and the memorial park adjacent to the ship (Munsanho), where 772 student volunteers aged 16 to 19 are commemorated with plaques and memorial stones, a sense of guilt overwhelmed me. These individuals were casualties of a feint operation launched along the East Coast in September 1950, during the Korean War (6·25 War), to divert enemy forces while UN troops executed the Incheon Landing Operation. A sigh escaped me: “I’m sorry for not knowing.”

spans.text: A social media (SNS) feed belonging to Kim, 34, a salaried worker, frequently features the daily lives of “well-off people” these days. Videos such as “Weekend Vlog of a 30-Year-Old Bannpo Mom,” “Daily Life of a 30-Something Office Worker Earning 100 Million Won Annually,” and “Weekend Solo Childcare of a Doctor’s Wife with Two Kids” appear. On screen, scenes of homes overlooking the Han River, fine dining, shopping at department stores, dermatology visits, and Pilates follow one after another. Kim said, “At first, I felt a sense of alienation, but as I kept watching, I felt vicarious satisfaction and was motivated.” Many people, like Kim, look up others’ affluent lives. While some criticize, saying, “They brag too much,” others respond, “It’s informative” or “I should work harder too.” They feel uncomfortable yet can’t look away, envy yet return to watch again. This is the landscape of a “subscription society of boasting.”

spans.text: On the 10th of last month, a prosecutor investigating the Daejang-dong case made an extreme attempt. It is truly regrettable that a prosecutor responsible for upholding our country’s legal order would engage in such an act. Moreover, he had undergone surgery to remove a kidney cancer tumor and was undergoing treatment at the time. He was in charge of the Daejang-dong investigation at the Seoul Central District Prosecutors’ Office from 2022 to early 2023. The issue arose on November 7 of last year. It was when Nam Wook, a witness in the Jeong Jin-sang bribery trial, reversed his previous stance. Since the witness had previously made statements unfavorable to President Lee Jae Myung, the judge asked for the reason. Nam claimed that Jeong Il-kwon, the prosecutor who investigated him, threatened him by saying, “I can cut open your stomach, remove all your organs, and excise the diseased part,” leading him to make a false statement. Prosecutor Jeong explained, “At the time, Mr. Nam was refusing to testify, so the intent was to explain that the investigation process is like a doctor’s treatment, allowing for the swift removal of the diseased part.” While this sounds more reasonable, Nam insists that Prosecutor Jeong genuinely threatened to cut him open.
spans.gt_tgt: 지난 4월 10일, 대장동 사건 수사 검사가 극단적 시도를 했다. 우리나라 법질서를 책임지는 검사가 그런 일을 벌인 것은 참으로 안타까운 일. 더구나 그는 신장암으로 절제 수술을 받고 치료 중이었다. 이 검사는 2022년부터 2023년 초까지 서울중앙지검에서 대장동 수사를 담당했다. 문제가 생긴 건 작년 11월 7일이었다. 정진상 뇌물 재판에 증인으로 나선 남욱씨가 그간의 입장을 번복한 것. 그간 이재명 대통령에게 불리한 진술을 하던 증인이었기에 판사는 그 이유를 묻는다. 남씨는 자신을 수사한 정일권 검사가 “배를 갈라서 장기를 다 꺼낼 수 있고, 환부를 도려낼 수 있다”고 협박해 거짓 진술을 했다고 말한다. 정 검사는 이렇게 해명한다. ‘그때는 남씨가 진술을 거부하는 상황’이었기에 ‘수사하는 과정이 의사가 치료하는 과정과 같기 때문에 신속하게 환부만 도려낼 수 있도록 설명해 달라는 취지’였다는 것. 상식적으로 이게 더 이치에 맞는 것 같지만, 남씨는 정 검사가 진짜로 배를 가른다고 협박한 것처럼 주장한다.

spans.text: The Democratic Party of Korea was confirmed on the 29th to have belatedly added “courts’ grounds for dismissal of prosecution” to a proposed amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act, which aims to completely abolish the prosecution’s right to supplementary investigations. Despite objections from the Ministry of Justice and the Supreme Prosecutors’ Office during a closed-door bill review session the previous night, the party pushed through the amendment without agreement from the opposition. The People Power Party criticized it as “President Lee Jae Myung’s trial-erasure law,” stating, “When it became difficult to introduce a special counsel to cancel the indictment, they created a detour to have courts dismiss the prosecution.” However, the Democratic Party proceeded to forcefully pass the amendment during a plenary session of the National Assembly’s Legislation and Judiciary Committee that day.
spans.gt_tgt: 더불어민주당이 검찰의 보완수사권 전면 폐지를 골자로 하는 형사소송법 개정안에 뒤늦게 ‘법원의 공소기각 사유’를 추가한 것으로 29일 확인됐다. 전날 밤 비공개 법안 심사 과정에서 법무부와 대검찰청이 반대 의견을 냈지만 야당과 합의 없이 밀어붙인 것이다. 국민의힘은 “이재명 대통령의 재판 지우기법”이라며 “공소취소 특검 도입이 어려워진다 싶으니까 이번에는 법원이 공소를 기각하도록 우회로를 만든 것”이라고 했다. 하지만 민주당은 이날 국회 법제사법위원회 전체회의를 열고 형소법 개정안을 강행 처리했다.

spans.text: Korea's Spring Bloom: Chaos and Beauty in Blossoms
spans.gt_tgt: 감사로 충만한 눈부신 봄 (16) [고혜련의 삶이 있는 풍경]
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: Following the brilliant month of April, May, the "Queen of Seasons," has arrived. In my not-so-short life, this fierce onslaught of flowers, so loud and vibrant, feels like a first. Across the nation, countless flower festivals erupted without pause, spurring a mass migration of citizens. Every neighborhood was indiscriminately blanketed in blossoms, and I raced breathlessly from one to another, unwilling to miss a single one. Starting with bright yellow forsythias and Cornus officinalis, azaleas and cherry blossoms swiftly enveloped the country, joined by pear, peach, and mountain camellia blossoms, followed by lilacs and azaleas, collectively painting the world in simultaneous splendor. Unlike past years, when flowers bloomed sequentially according to weather and tree conditions, this year’s "simultaneous blooming" led to remarks that the "spring flower clock had tangled." Global warming, it seems, caused the "accumulated temperature" required for blooming to be reached early, prompting flowers to burst open in a chaotic rush.
spans.gt_tgt: 결코 짧지 않은 내 생애 중, 이렇게 요란·화려하게 빛났던 꽃들의 맹렬한 돌격은 처음인 것 같다. 전국 곳곳에서 다양한 꽃 축제를 쉼 없이 열어 전 국민의 대이동을 부추겼다. 가는 동네마다 차별 없이 꽃으로 뒤덮여 이들을 놓칠세라 숨차도록 꽃구경을 다녔다. 샛노란 개나리와 산수유를 시작으로 진달래·벚꽃이 전국을 순식간에 휘감고 배꽃·복사꽃·산당화 그리고 라일락·철쭉까지 합세해 천지를 동시다발적으로 화려하게 물들였다. 예전처럼 날씨와 나무들의 상황에 따라 순차적으로 폈던 꽃들이 ‘동시 개화’를 하니 “봄꽃시계가 엉켰다”는 말까지 나왔다. 지구온난화로 개화에 필요한 ‘적산온도’가 일찍 차버려 꽃들이 서둘러 ‘와장창’ 피어버렸다는 것이다.

spans.text: Stability AI, a British artificial intelligence (AI) company, announced on the 25th (local time) that it had secured an investment of 76 million dollars (approximately 105 billion Korean won). spans.text: Lotte Group announced on the 13th that it has completed the construction of the ‘Lotte x KAIST R&D Center’ together with KAIST (Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology). The building, located at KAIST’s main campus in Daejeon, spans from basement level 1 to the 6th floor above ground, with a total floor area of 4,298 square meters. spans.text: Mercedes-Benz has set the domestic price of its new electric CLA model approximately 30 million Korean won lower than in its home market of Germany. spans.text: The issue of building housing in large urban parks and green spaces is not unique to South Korea. Global cities grappling with severe rent hikes and housing shortages have also turned to "park development" as their last card to expand supply. The key was the approach. Development that bypassed social consensus not only failed to expedite supply but led to conflict and project stagnation. Berlin’s Tempelhof Park in Germany is a prime example.
spans.gt_tgt: 도심 대형 공원과 녹지에 주택을 짓는 문제는 우리만의 고민이 아니다. 극심한 집세 상승과 주택 부족에 시달리는 세계 대도시들도 공급 확대의 마지막 카드로 ‘공원 개발’을 꺼내 들었다. 관건은 추진 방식이었다. 사회적 합의라는 관문을 건너뛴 개발은 공급을 앞당기기는커녕 갈등과 사업 표류로 귀결됐다. 독일 베를린의 템펠호프 공원이 대표적인 사례다.

spans.text: Truly, this is the era of algorithms. Before I knew it, I felt trapped in a vast pit. spans.text: The Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency announced on September 4 that large-scale traffic controls will be implemented ahead of the ‘Seoul International Fireworks Festival’ scheduled for September 5 at Yeouido Han River Park. spans.text: Incheon’s administrative map will change starting July 1. The Yeongjongdo area, which was part of Jung-gu under the administrative district, will become ‘Yeongjong-gu’, and Jung-gu and Dong-gu, after separating Yeongjongdo, will merge to form ‘Jemulpo-gu’. The area around Geomdan New City will be separated from Seo-gu to become ‘Geomdan-gu’, and Seo-gu will be renamed ‘Seohae-gu’. As a result, Incheon will become the first major city in the country with no districts using so-called ‘directional place names’ like Jung-gu and Nam-gu.

spans.text: The prosecution is expected to start operating a "smart work center" as early as July, allowing prosecutors to work outside their affiliated prosecutors' office buildings, it was learned on the 14th. Last year, most criminal case investigation records were digitized. Accordingly, it was reported that except for in-person investigations and court appearances, remote work has become possible, and they plan to pilot the smart work center, which is akin to a shared office. As the possibility of abolishing even prosecutors' supplementary investigation rights ahead of the establishment of the indictment agency in October emerges, there are reactions within the prosecution that "the operation of the smart work center symbolically shows the abolition of prosecutors' investigative authority."

spans.text: Recently, over 50 high school classmates from a girls’ school participated in a tour of Taephung Observatory in Yeoncheon, Gyeonggi Province. spans.text: The Korea Workers' Compensation & Welfare Service (KWCWS) mistakenly continued paying medical benefits to a construction worker who became paralyzed below the waist in an industrial accident, even after the payment period ended in May 2024. spans.text: Volkswagen Group, the world’s second-largest automaker, is reportedly pursuing its largest-ever restructuring plan, including potential layoffs of up to 100,000 people. This follows years of accumulated challenges: high fixed costs at its German production hubs, failed electric vehicle (EV) transitions, sluggish performance in China, and U.S. tariff burdens. spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: The ruling and opposition parties have discussed measures to prevent satellite parties since their emergence in 2020, but no substantial progress has been made. Recent controversies surrounding Yong Hye-in, a ministerial candidate for the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family who was elected as a proportional representative lawmaker twice through the Democratic Party of Korea’s satellite party, have reignited criticism of the harmful effects of satellite parties. However, political circles warn, “If the Democratic Party and the People Power Party do not take active steps, the two parties’ satellite party tactics are likely to recur in the 2028 general election.”
spans.gt_tgt: 여야는 2020년 위성정당이 등장한 때부터 이를 막는 방안을 거론해 왔으나, 실질적인 진척은 없는 상태다. 더불어민주당 위성정당으로 두 차례 비례대표 국회의원에 당선된 용혜인 성평등가족부 장관 후보자를 두고 최근 각종 논란이 일면서 위성정당의 폐해에 대한 지적이 다시 나오지만, 정치권에서는 “민주당과 국민의힘이 적극적으로 나서지 않는다면 다음 2028년 총선에서도 양당의 위성정당 꼼수가 되풀이될 가능성이 높다”는 말이 나온다.

spans.text: The Ministry of Employment and Labor has clarified that the so-called “N% performance bonus,” which requires a fixed percentage of operating profits as performance-based pay, cannot be considered a mandatory bargaining item. This means labor unions striking to enforce such demands would struggle to gain legitimacy. Conversely, if concrete plans emerge for relocating existing employees due to new factory construction, the company must negotiate with the union.
spans.gt_tgt: 고용노동부가 영업이익의 일정 비율을 성과급으로 요구하는 이른바 ‘N% 성과급’을 의무 교섭 대상으로 볼 수 없다고 못 박았다. 노동조합이 이를 관철하려고 파업하면 정당성을 인정받기 어렵다는 뜻이다. 반면 공장 신설 등에 따른 기존 직원의 배치 전환 등이 구체화되면 회사가 노조와 교섭해야 한다고 했다.

spans.text: Another police-officer-turned-official with no airport work experience has been appointed as the head of Korea Airports Corporation, which oversees 14 domestic airports excluding Incheon International Airport. This marks the fifth police-officer-turned-president since the corporation’s establishment in 2002. The aviation industry has criticized the repeated “parachute appointments” amid mounting issues such as chronic deficits at regional airports and the aftermath of the passenger plane crash at Muan Airport.

spans.text: Second Special Counsel Concludes Amid Controversy
spans.gt_tgt: 최다 인원·최장 수사에도… 2차 특검, 논란 남기고 끝나
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: The second special counsel (Special Counsel Kwon Chang-young) concluded its activities on the 23rd and will announce its final investigation results at 11 a.m. on the 24th. By the final day, the second special counsel had arrested and indicted seven individuals and indicted without arrest 51 people, including corporate entities. At its launch, the second special counsel described itself as the “sword of the Constitution” and pledged to “maintain maximum political neutrality and fairness, investigating thoroughly without sanctuaries, following only the direction indicated by law and evidence.” The second special counsel operated for a record 180 days alongside the insurrection special counsel and the special counsel team investigating former first lady Kim Keon-hee, after the Special Counsel Act was amended midway. It also expanded its personnel to 271 members, the largest in the history of special counsels. However, legal circles criticized the probe, stating, “Controversies over excessive investigations and political bias followed the special counsel throughout its tenure.” The second special counsel faced accusations of employing a “heavy tail” strategy, rushing to indict around 40 individuals in the final two weeks. Approximately half of these were charged with insurrection-related offenses.
spans.gt_tgt: 2차 종합특검(특별검사 권창영)이 23일을 끝으로 활동을 종료하고, 24일 오전 11시 최종 수사 결과를 발표한다. 2차 특검은 이날까지 7명을 구속 기소하고, 법인을 포함해 51명을 불구속 기소했다. 2차 특검은 출범 당시 ‘헌법의 검(劍)’이라고 자처하며 “정치적 중립성과 공정성을 최대한 유지하면서 오로지 법률과 증거가 지시하는 방향에 따라 성역 없이 철저히 수사할 것”이라고 했다. 2차 특검은 중간에 특검법이 수정돼 내란·김건희 특검과 함께 역대 최장 기간인 180일간 수사했다. 인력도 역대 특검 중 가장 많은 271명으로 늘렸다. 그러나 법조계에선 “특검 수사 기간 내내 무리한 수사, 정치적 편향성 등 논란이 따라다녔다”는 말이 나왔다. 2차 특검은 막판 사건 처분을 몰아 하는 ‘헤비테일(Heavy tail·막판 몰아치기) 전략’이라며 지난 2주간 40여 명을 무더기로 재판에 넘겼다. 이 중 절반가량은 내란 관련 혐의로 기소됐다.

spans.text: Education Grants to Keep Rising Despite Student Decline
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: The government is changing the calculation method for local education subsidies (grants) used in elementary, middle, and high school education for the first time in 55 years. The key change shifts from an automatic allocation of 20.79% of domestic taxes to a formula reflecting student population changes and economic conditions. However, even with this revised formula, the government has guaranteed that the total grant amount will not decrease compared to the previous year—a concession to the education sector’s opposition. This has drawn criticism that the reform is “too weak given the sharp decline in student numbers.”
spans.gt_tgt: 정부가 55년 만에 초·중·고 교육에 사용하는 지방교육재정교부금(교부금) 산정 방식을 바꾼다. 내국세의 20.79%를 자동 배정하는 방식에서 학생 수 변화와 경제 상황을 반영하는 식으로 바뀌는 게 핵심이다. 하지만 이렇게 산식이 바뀌어도 교부금 규모가 전년보다 줄지 않도록 보장하기로 했다. 개편에 반대하는 교육계 입장을 반영한 것이다. 이 때문에 “학생 수가 급감하는 정도에 비해 개편 강도가 너무 낮다”는 비판도 나온다.

spans.text: Prosecution's Command Over Special Judicial Police Ends in October
spans.gt_tgt: 두달 뒤 검사 지휘 사라지는데… '2만 특사경' 새 수사체계는 감감무소식
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: The prosecution’s investigative command authority over special judicial police will be abolished on October 2, alongside the closure of the prosecution office. The revised Criminal Procedure Act replaces the previous "investigative command" system with "mutual cooperation," delegating the specifics of cooperation to a presidential decree. However, with less than two months until implementation, the decree has yet to be finalized. Over 20,000 special judicial police officers remain uncertain about the legal basis for their cooperation with prosecutors as the new system begins.
spans.gt_tgt: 오는 10월 2일 검찰청 폐지와 함께 특별사법경찰(특사경)에 대한 검사의 수사 지휘권도 사라진다. 개정 형사소송법은 그 자리를 ‘수사 지휘’에서 ‘상호 협력’으로 바꾸면서 구체적인 협력 방식은 대통령령으로 정하도록 했다. 그러나 시행을 두 달도 남기지 않은 현재까지 이 대통령령은 나오지 않았다. 2만여 명에 이르는 특사경이 어떤 규정을 근거로 검사와 협력할지 정해지지 않은 채 새 체계가 시작되는 것이다.

spans.text: The Democratic Party of Korea plans to hold a plenary session of the National Assembly on the 20th, three days after electing a new party leader, to push forward with a "legislative speed war." spans.text: The government has begun reforming the unemployment benefits system to prevent an "income reversal" phenomenon, where the amount received from unemployment benefits (job-seeking benefits) exceeds the net income of minimum-wage workers. Critics have long argued that unemployment benefits being higher than minimum-wage workers’ net income "reduces the incentive to work," and the government aims to address this. A key proposal under consideration is lowering the monthly unemployment benefit amount while extending the total payment period.

spans.text: Exclusive: Top-Grade Surge Fuels Dropout Fears Among Students

spans.text: Last year, with the first implementation of the ‘5-grade internal evaluation system,’ it was found that over 4,500 first-year high school students (now second-year) nationwide received the top grade in all subjects in their internal evaluations. This is more than six times the number from 2024, when the 9-grade system was in place, and nearly five times the enrollment capacity of metropolitan medical schools. There were many concerns that the 5-grade system would significantly reduce the system’s ability to differentiate students, and this has now become a reality. There are worries that the trend of students dropping out of school to focus solely on the college entrance exam will increase, as the belief that ‘missing the top grade in even one subject means failing to get into medical school’ spreads.
spans.gt_tgt: 지난해 ‘내신 5등급제’가 처음 실시된 가운데, 내신 시험에서 전 과목 1등급을 받은 고등학교 1학년(현재 고2)이 전국적으로 4500명이 넘은 것으로 나타났다. 내신 9등급제를 적용하던 2024년보다 6배 이상이 됐고, 수도권 의대 입학 정원의 5배에 가깝다. 내신이 5등급제가 되면 변별력이 크게 떨어질 것이란 우려가 많았는데, 현실로 나타난 것이다. ‘한 과목이라도 1등급을 놓치면 의대에 못 간다’는 생각에 학교를 자퇴하고 수능에만 집중하자는 분위기가 늘어날 것이란 우려가 나온다.

spans.text: Serious Accidents Punishment Act Fails to Reduce Workplace Deaths
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: I was deeply shocked to hear on the broadcast that a vehicle veered onto the sidewalk due to driver negligence, causing multiple casualties. Above all, I felt a deep sense of sorrow for the innocent victims. The thought that even while walking on a sidewalk, which I believed to be safe, one could suffer an unexpected accident made it feel like it could happen to anyone. In particular, I was shocked to learn that the fence—a barrier installed between the road and sidewalk—failed to protect pedestrians at all. When I saw the metal fence while walking on the sidewalk, I expected it to block vehicles and protect pedestrians even if a car crashed onto the sidewalk. However, in reality, the fence crumpled like paper in front of a speeding vehicle and did not fulfill its role of protecting pedestrians. Then, why are such useless facilities installed with taxpayers’ money?
spans.gt_tgt: 방송에서 운전자의 과실로 차량이 인도로 돌진해 다수의 인명 피해가 발생했다는 소식을 접하고 큰 충격을 받은 적이 있다. 무엇보다 무고한 희생자들에 대한 안타까운 마음이 컸다. 안전하다고 믿었던 인도를 걷다가도 불의의 사고를 당할 수 있다는 생각을 하니 남의 일처럼 느껴지지 않았다. 특히 개인적으로, 차도와 인도 사이에 설치된 울타리인 펜스가 보행자들을 전혀 보호하지 못했다는 사실이 충격적이었다. 인도를 걸으면서 철제 펜스를 보면 자동차가 인도로 돌진하더라도 이 펜스가 자동차를 막아 보행자들을 보호해 줄 것이라고 기대했다. 하지만 현실에서 이 펜스는 돌진하는 자동차 앞에서 종잇장처럼 구겨져 버릴 뿐 보행자를 보호하는 역할을 제대로 하지 못했다. 그렇다면 도대체 이런 무용지물인 시설물을 국민의 혈세로 설치하는 이유는 무엇인가?

spans.text: Korean Startups Must Pass 'Mother' and 'Spouse' Tests First
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: Whether starting a business in Silicon Valley, Tokyo, Beijing, Seoul, or any city worldwide, the beginning of a startup is the 'MVP (Minimum Viable Product) test.' This involves creating a product or service with minimal features first to receive customer feedback. If the results are poor, the business model is revised, or the venture is abandoned altogether to seek other opportunities. In Korea, there are even more challenging 'mother tests' and 'spouse tests.' To start a business, unmarried individuals must first overcome the 'parent' hurdle, while married individuals face the 'spouse' (or husband) hurdle before the MVP test.
spans.gt_tgt: 실리콘밸리, 도쿄, 베이징, 서울 등 세계 어느 도시에서 창업하든 스타트업의 시작은 ‘MVP(Minimum Viable Product) 테스트’다. 최소 기능의 제품이나 서비스를 먼저 만들어 고객의 피드백을 받는 일이다. 결과가 안 좋으면 사업 모델을 수정하거나, 아예 포기하고 다른 기회를 찾는 식이다. 한국엔 이보다 더욱 어려운 ‘마더 테스트’와 ‘배우자 테스트’가 있다. 일단 창업을 하려면 MVP 테스트 이전에 미혼자는 ‘부모’, 기혼자는 ‘아내’(또는 남편)라는 허들부터 넘어야 한다는 얘기다.

spans.text: President Lee Jae Myung’s remarks at the July 23 real estate grand debate revealed the outline of an upcoming tax reform. spans.text: Jeonbuk Province announced on the 25th that it will pay a monthly allowance of 100,000 Korean won to 723 descendants of Donghak Peasant Revolution participants residing in Jeonbuk. The Donghak Peasant Revolution began 132 years ago in 1894 in Gobu (now Jeongeup), Jeonbuk, and spread nationwide.

spans.text: Scalping Persists Despite New Anti-Scalping Laws
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: The government and the Democratic Party of Korea declared a “war on scalped tickets” last November, and the so-called “three anti-scalping laws” (amendments to the Performance Act, National Sports Promotion Act, and Sports Facilities Installation Act) went into effect on the 28th. The key provision imposes fines up to 50 times the amount of illegal ticket sales. Already, under existing laws, selling scalped tickets in professional sports and performances can result in up to one year in prison or a fine of up to 10 million Korean won. However, on the 20th, the largest domestic ticket resale site, Ticketbay, listed pro baseball game tickets—originally priced around 20,000 Korean won—at 100,000 Korean won, and concert tickets—originally around 200,000 Korean won—at 1 million Korean won. Why do scalped ticket transactions persist despite the government’s crackdown?
spans.gt_tgt: 정부와 더불어민주당이 지난해 11월 ‘암표와의 전쟁’을 선언하고 마련한 이른바 ‘암표 3법(공연법·국민체육진흥법·체육시설설치법 개정안)’이 28일 시행에 들어간다. 암표 판매 금액의 최대 50배를 과징금으로 물리는 게 핵심이다. 이미 프로 스포츠와 공연 분야는 관련 법에 따라 암표를 팔다 적발되면 1년 이하 징역 또는 1000만원 이하 벌금에 처해진다. 하지만 20일 국내 최대 티켓 양도 사이트 ‘티켓베이’에는 정가 2만원 안팎인 프로야구 경기 티켓이 10만원, 20만원 정도인 콘서트 티켓은 100만원에 올라와 있었다. 당정이 암표 근절에 팔을 걷어붙였는데도 암표 거래가 판을 치는 까닭은 뭘까.

spans.text: Pine Wilt Disease Spreads Despite 38 Years and 2 Trillion Won

spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: On August 12, a pine nut forest in Sangsaek-ri, Gapyeong County, Gyeonggi Province. The mountainside, which should have been covered in deep green during midsummer, was dotted with pine nut trees that had turned red as if scorched by fire. Upon closer inspection, the needles had lost their vitality and turned crimson. Some trees had shed all their leaves, leaving only bare branches. They had died from pine wilt disease. As we ventured deeper into the forest, more trees that had dried and turned red appeared one after another.
spans.gt_tgt: 지난 12일 경기 가평군 상색리 한 잣나무 숲. 한여름 짙은 녹색으로 뒤덮여 있어야 할 산자락에 불에 그슬린 듯 붉게 변한 잣나무들이 듬성듬성 박혀 있었다. 가까이 가보니 바늘잎이 생기를 잃고 붉게 변해 있었다. 일부 나무는 잎이 모두 떨어져 앙상한 가지만 남았다. 소나무 재선충병에 걸려 고사한 것이다. 숲 안으로 들어갈수록 붉게 말라 죽은 나무가 꼬리를 물고 나타났다.

spans.text: Busan North Port Complex Transfer Center Faces Construction Halt Risk
spans.gt_tgt: 부산 북항 복합환승센터, 법적 분쟁에 공사 중단 위기

spans.text: The construction of the complex transfer center, a key facility in the redevelopment of Busan’s North Port, is facing the risk of suspension. This is because Busan Port Authority, which owns the North Port site, and the developer are engaged in a legal dispute. The North Port complex transfer center is a transportation hub connecting Busan Station and the Busan Port International Passenger Terminal. It will allow people to transfer between KTX, cruise ships, buses, and other modes of transportation on foot. It will also connect to the dome stadium that Mayor Chun Jae-soo plans to build on the North Port site.
spans.gt_tgt: 부산 북항 재개발 부지의 핵심 시설인 복합 환승 센터 공사가 중단될 위기에 처했다. 북항 부지를 소유한 부산항만공사와 사업자가 법적 공방을 벌이고 있어서다. 북항 복합 환승 센터는 부산역과 부산항국제여객터미널 등을 잇는 교통 허브(hub)다. 걸어서 KTX와 크루즈, 버스 등을 갈아탈 수 있게 만든다. 전재수 부산시장이 북항 부지에 지으려는 돔구장과도 연결된다.

spans.text: Women's Groups Warn Amendment Risks Victim Rights Regression
spans.gt_tgt: 여성단체, 보완수사권 폐지 우려 "피해자에 개악되면 안 된다"
