spans.text: Six women’s groups, including Lawyers for a Democratic Society (Minbyun) Women’s National Human Rights Commission, have expressed concerns over the proposed amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act. They criticized the amendment, which includes the abolition of the prosecution’s right to supplementary investigations, stating, “The process of discovering substantive truth will be reduced,” and emphasized, “The amendment must not become a ‘regression’ for victims.” Recently, multiple cases of inadequate police investigations, which were later addressed through supplementary investigations by prosecutors, have been uncovered, leading to ongoing criticism of the amendment.
spans.gt_tgt: 민주사회를 위한 변호사 모임(민변) 여성인권위원회 등 6개 여성단체가 형사소송법 개정안에 대한 우려를 표명했다. 이들은 검찰의 보완수사권 폐지 등을 담은 개정안에 대해 “실체적 진실을 발견하는 과정이 축소될 것”이라며 “개정안이 피해자에게 ‘개악’이 되면 안 된다”고 지적했다. 최근 검찰의 보완수사를 통한 경찰의 부실수사 사례가 여럿 발견되며 보완수사권 폐지 등을 담은 형사소송법 개정안에 대한 비판이 계속되고 있다.

spans.text: Stable Power Supply Key to National Competitiveness
spans.gt_tgt: "안정적 전기 공급이 국가 경쟁력… 원전·재생에너지 함께 가야"

spans.text: The government’s announcement on June 29 of the “three mega projects,” including the Honam Semiconductor Cluster and an artificial intelligence (AI) data center, has made securing stable power supply the top priority for the energy sector. Semiconductor fabs and AI data centers are representative high-energy-consuming facilities that operate 24/7. Amid the decarbonization trend, expanding renewable energy like solar and wind while ensuring uninterrupted power despite nighttime and weather fluctuations has emerged as the biggest challenge for national energy strategy. Experts also emphasize that expanding power generation sources and investing in grids must go hand in hand, as concentrated power demand in specific regions could strain transmission networks.
spans.gt_tgt: 지난달 29일 정부가 호남 반도체 클러스터와 인공지능(AI) 데이터센터 조성을 포함한 ‘3대 메가 프로젝트’를 발표하면서, 이를 뒷받침할 전력을 어떻게 공급하느냐가 에너지 업계의 최대 현안으로 떠올랐다.

spans.text: The Korean Bar Association on July 10 opposed a revision to the Criminal Procedure Act aimed at abolishing the prosecution's right to supplementary investigations. The Lawyers for a Democratic Society (Minbyun)'s Women's National Human Rights Commission also recently expressed public concern, stating, "If the prosecution's right to supplementary investigations is abolished, crime victims could suffer judicial harm due to inadequate investigations." Criticism of abolishing the prosecution's right to supplementary investigations continues within the legal community.

spans.text: Myeongdong Street in Seoul offers various genres of enjoyment. Myeongdong is a food paradise, a holy site for K-beauty, and a shopping mecca. From various fashion brands to department stores, duty-free shops, discount stores, and specialty stores for daily necessities, everything is within a few blocks. It truly satisfies all five senses. With more foreign tourists than locals, it sometimes feels like being on a trip abroad. It is also a base for traveling around Seoul, as it is convenient to walk to Namdaemun Market, Namsan Tower, Cheonggyecheon, Insadong, and other areas.

spans.text: Controversy has spread to the political sphere after Paichai High School’s baseball team, which chanted the slogan “We should go to Starbucks” toward Gwangju Jeil High School players during a high school baseball game, received a “6 units월 출전 정지” disciplinary action. The People Power Party and other opposition parties stated, “While it is not the right action, should we block the future of high school athletes with such a severe punishment?” In contrast, the Democratic Party of Korea went as far as to argue that the dissolution of the baseball team should be considered. Paichai High School had previously apologized through its website and other channels after receiving criticism that the “We should go to Starbucks” slogan evoked the controversy surrounding Starbucks’ “5·18 Tank Day” event last May.

spans.text: The National Plant Construction Labor Union announced on the 1st that it will launch a total strike next month against eight major companies, including Hyundai Engineering & Construction, S-Oil, and SK Ecoplant. This marks the first time a subcontractor union has explicitly revealed plans to strike against primary contractors since the implementation of the Yellow Envelope Law in March. If the strike proceeds, disruptions to projects such as SK Hynix’s semiconductor cluster construction in Yongin, Gyeonggi Province, are expected to be unavoidable.
spans.gt_tgt: 전국플랜트건설노동조합이 다음 달 현대건설, 에쓰오일, SK에코플랜트 등 8개 대기업을 상대로 총파업에 나서겠다고 1일 밝혔다. 지난 3월 노란봉투법 시행 후, 하청 노조가 원청 업체를 상대로 파업 계획을 구체적으로 밝힌 건 이번이 처음이다. 실제 파업이 진행되면 SK하이닉스의 경기도 용인 반도체 클러스터 조성 공사 등에 차질이 불가피할 것으로 전망된다.

spans.gt_tgt: "법보다 남편 주먹이 가까웠다"… 11년 매맞은 아내, 끝없는 고통

spans.text: Cha Miso (pseudonym, 38)’s 11-year marriage was marred by her husband’s violence, threats, and obsession. From the moment they registered their marriage in 2011 after a short relationship and an unexpected pregnancy, the harassment by her husband, Kim Hyungsoo (pseudonym, 39), began. Kim would hurl insults and burn Cha’s arm with a lit cigarette over minor disputes. Kim secretly ran a prostitution business and served a four-year prison sentence. Cha said, “The four years my husband was in prison were the only peaceful period in our 11-year marriage. But after his release, the hellish life resumed.”
spans.gt_tgt: 11년간 이어진 차미소(가명·38)씨의 결혼 생활은 남편의 폭력과 협박, 집착으로 얼룩져 있다. 2011년 짧은 연애 후 예기치 않은 임신으로 혼인 신고를 한 순간부터, 남편 김형수(가명·39)씨의 괴롭힘이 시작됐다. 김씨는 사소한 일로 다투어 기분이 나쁘면 막말을 퍼붓고 담뱃불로 차씨의 팔을 지졌다. 김씨는 가족 몰래 성매매 사업을 하다가 4년간 실형도 살았다. 차씨는 “남편이 교도소에 가 있었던 4년이 11년 결혼 생활 중 유일하게 마음 편한 기간이었다”며 “하지만 남편 출소 후 지옥 같은 생활이 다시 시작됐다”고 했다.

spans.text: Medical School-Bound Homes Fetch Premium Prices

spans.text: A powerful phrase that stirs every Mrs. Meng in South Korea. A few days ago, a constructed apartment in Bundang, Gyeonggi-do, was listed for sale. The description noted, “A house with no inter-floor noise and ideal for studying,” followed by the bold claim, “Entering Medical School.” Upon contacting the homeowner, they explained, “My son passed the entrance exam for a Seoul-based medical school here and is now in his final year. I wrote it to help the house sell.” While the neighborhood is classified as a school district with high academic achievement and favored by parents, this case stands out by leveraging an actual success story as a unique selling point to justify relocation.

spans.text: The ‘ballot shortage crisis’ began as the National Election Commission (NEC) printed fewer main ballots than during the 2014 local elections. As pre-voting rates rose in every election, the NEC had printed ballots for “over 60% of voters” but reduced this to “over 50%,” a miscalculation. spans.text: Postpartum Care Agencies Shun Twins, Demand Extra Fees
spans.gt_tgt: "일 힘들어 안 맡겠다" "하루 5만원 더 내라"… 쌍둥이는 서러워

spans.text: A, who is expecting twins, was taken aback while researching the government-supported postpartum care service ahead of childbirth. She called five nearby agencies, but four refused, saying, “We don’t take twins.” The one agency that accepted her said, “An additional fee is required.” Caregivers reportedly avoid twin households because the daily wage for caring for twins is nearly the same as for a single child, despite the added difficulty. Typically, two caregivers visit twin households, each attending to one child. However, unlike single-child households where caregivers can rest when the baby sleeps, twins often have different sleep schedules, leaving caregivers with no time to rest. Moreover, the daily wage for twin households is 109,000 Korean won, while for general households it is 106,000 Korean won—a difference of only 3,000 Korean won.
spans.gt_tgt: 쌍둥이를 임신한 A씨는 출산을 앞두고 정부가 지원하는 산후 도우미 서비스를 알아보다 당황했다. 집 근처 업체 5곳에 전화를 돌렸는데 4곳이 “쌍둥이는 안 된다”며 거절했다. 가능하다는 업체 1곳도 “추가금을 내야 한다”고 했다. 쌍둥이를 돌보는 게 더 힘든데 받는 일당은 아이 1명인 가정과 별 차이가 없어서 도우미들이 꺼리기 때문이라고 한다. 보통 쌍둥이 가정엔 도우미 2명이 가서 각각 1명씩 돌본다. 하지만 아이가 잘 때 도우미가 쉴 수 있는 아이 1명인 가정과 달리, 쌍둥이들은 수면 시간이 달라서 도우미가 쉴 시간이 없다는 것이다. 게다가 일당은 쌍둥이 집은 10만9000원, 일반 가정은 10만6000원으로 3000원밖에 차이가 안 난다.

spans.text: There is a saying these days that “the difficulty of reserving a Temple Stay is almost as high as university course registration.” As Buddhism gains a ‘hip’ reputation and interest in temple cuisine grows, Temple Stays and temple visits have become popular as a wellness travel method. Amid this trend, I headed to the foothills of Jirisan in Sancheong, Gyeongsangnam-do, where renowned temples and serene hermitages are hidden. From the restaurant serving the temple cuisine of Monk Daean, who gained fame in the Wavve (Wave) series *Chefs of the Buddhist Kitchen* at Geumsusam Hermitage, to the pilgrimage path honoring the legacy of Monk Seongcheol, a revered “great monk,” I explored temples that have garnered attention. Even if it’s not *Buddha's Birthday*, this season when the forests are most beautiful, a temple trip amid the woods can be a fail-proof choice regardless of religion. A day spent eating well, walking slowly, and cultivating the mind.

spans.text: Democratic Party Pushes Constitutional Amendment Without Opposition Consensus
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: A constitutional amendment bill led by the Democratic Party of Korea was put to a plenary session of the National Assembly on the 7th, but its processing failed as the People Power Party did not participate. Although a bill rejected in a plenary session cannot be resubmitted during the same session, National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik and the Democratic Party stated, “The vote was invalid due to a lack of quorum,” and plan to reprocess the amendment in the plenary session on the 8th. The People Power Party has consistently opposed the amendment since its inception, arguing, “We do not oppose the content, but a rushed constitutional revision ahead of local elections is unacceptable.” Political circles criticize the ruling party for pushing forward with the amendment—South Korea’s first in 39 years since 1987—without consensus from the main opposition party, calling it a “predicted failure.”
spans.gt_tgt: 더불어민주당이 주도한 헌법 개정안이 7일 국회 본회의에 상정됐지만 국민의힘이 불참해 처리가 무산됐다. 본회의에 상정된 안건이 부결되면 같은 회기에 다시 상정할 수 없지만 우원식 국회의장과 민주당은 “의결정족수 부족에 따른 투표 불성립”이라며 8일 본회의에서 개헌안을 다시 처리할 계획이다. 국민의힘은 개헌 추진 초기부터 “내용은 반대하지 않지만 지방선거를 앞둔 졸속 개헌을 해서는 안 된다”고 해왔다. 정치권에선 집권 여당이 1987년 이후 39년만에 개헌을 추진하면서 제1 야당과 합의 없이 밀어붙이다 벌어진 ‘예고된 파행’이라는 지적이 나온다.

spans.text: GS Engineering & Construction has opened a model house for ‘Mokdong Yunseul Jai’ in Mokdong, Yangcheon-gu, Seoul, and will begin accepting subscription applications on the 8th. Mokdong Yunseul Jai is being developed on the former KT site at 924, 924-3, and 5 Mokdong, Yangcheon-gu, spanning three buildings with six underground floors to 48 above-ground floors, and 651 units with exclusive areas ranging from 114 to 203㎡. spans.text: September 9th is "Organ Donation Day." It carries the meaning of SAVE9, referring to the fact that donating organs upon brain death can save up to 9 people’s lives. spans.gt_tgt: 매년 9월 9일은 ‘장기기증의 날’이다. 뇌사에 빠졌을 때 장기 기증을 하면 최대 9명의 생명을 구할 수 있다는 의미(SAVE9)를 담고있다. 심장, 간, 췌장, 신장 2개, 폐 2개, 각막 2개를 이식할 수 있기 때문이다. 9일 장기기증의 날을 맞아 기증인과 이식인이 한자리에 모였다.

spans.gt_tgt: 너무 빨리 사라지는 히말라야 빙설… 한편선 홍수, 한편선 물부족 우려

spans.text: Snow that fell across the Hindu Kush-Himalaya (HKH) highlands, spanning eight countries from Afghanistan to Myanmar last winter, remained on the ground for the shortest duration on record. The "snow cover duration"—a metric indicating how long snow remains on the surface during winter—hit its lowest level since observations began in 2003. While snow that accumulated over past winters used to stay on glaciers longer, slowing ice melt, rapid melting due to warming has heightened flood risks.
spans.gt_tgt: 지난 겨울 아프가니스탄부터 미얀마까지 8국에 걸친 힌두쿠시-히말라야(HKH) 고산지대에 내린 눈이 지표에 머문 기간이 가장 짧았던 것으로 나타났다. 겨울철 눈이 지표를 덮고 있는 기간을 나타내는 ‘적설 지속도’가 2003년 관측 이후 최저치를 기록한 것이다. 과거엔 겨우내 내린 눈이 빙하 위에 오래 덮여 있으면서 얼음이 녹는 걸 막아줬지만 온난화 여파로 눈이 빨리 녹으면서 홍수 위험을 키운 것으로 분석된다.

spans.text: The Civil Division 33 of the Seoul Central District Court (Presiding Judge Choi Jong-jin) ruled in favor of the plaintiff, Industrial Bank of Korea, in a rent claim lawsuit filed against CGV. The court ordered CGV to pay 15.322 billion Korean won, stating that CGV should compensate for the remaining rent and fees for the contract period. The ruling emphasized that it was difficult to recognize CGV’s closure as being directly caused by COVID-19-related business difficulties, as approximately three years had passed between the end of防疫 measures and the theater’s closure.

spans.text: South Korea's 1,900 One-Person Health Clinics Struggle With Overload
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: At 9 a.m. on August 6, at the Wonchang Health Clinic in Dongsan-myeon, Chuncheon City, Gangwon Province, Park Mi-ae, 43 years old, the clinic’s director, had just arrived for work when a village resident, Lee Mo, 86 years old, in an electric wheelchair, knocked on the clinic door. Lee, looking worried, said, “My urine is cloudy.” Three weeks ago, he had received anti-inflammatory medication from a hospital in the city and his condition had improved, but the symptoms reappeared that morning. spans.text: Lee Mi-yeon, 43 years old (pseudonym), who lives in Gyeongsan, Gyeongsangbuk-do, has twin sons she cherishes deeply. Perhaps due to her late marriage and even later childbirth, her two sons were born prematurely. Like most premature infants, her sons also required rehabilitation. According to specialists, premature infants are generally born before their development is complete. Particularly in musculoskeletal development, premature infants may have weak muscles and skeletal structures, which can lead to issues with mobility and balance. This was the case with Lee’s two sons. When she sought a rehabilitation medical institution for her children, she found it difficult to locate one in the Daegu-Gyeongbuk region. In the end, she had to travel to large hospitals in the capital area. The financial burden was significant, but witnessing her children struggling in the car during long-distance trips was an unbearable pain.
spans.gt_tgt: 경북 경산에 사는 이미연(43·가명)씨는 눈에 넣어도 아프지 않은 쌍둥이 아들이 있다. 늦은 결혼에 더 늦어진 출산 탓인지 두 아들은 조산아로 세상에 나왔다. 대부분 조산아들이 그러하듯 두 아들도 재활이 필요했다. 전문의들에 따르면, 조산아는 일반적으로 발달이 완료되지 않은 상태에서 태어난다. 특히 근골격계 발달에 있어 조산아는 약한 근육 및 골격 구조를 가질 수 있으며, 이로 인해 이동성과 평형 감각에 문제가 발생할 수 있다. 이씨의 두 아들도 그랬다. 두 아이 재활을 위해 재활 의료 기관을 찾았지만, 대구·경북 지역에서는 찾기 어려웠다. 결국 수도권에 있는 대형 병원을 오가야 했다. 경제적 부담도 적지 않지만, 장거리를 오가며 차 안에서 힘들어하는 아이들을 보는 건 참기 힘든 고통이었다.

spans.text: On the morning of the 26th, honor guard soldiers at Incheon International Airport Terminal 2 in Jung-gu, Incheon, carried the portraits and remains of the late André Dacarli (front photo) and the late Jacques Grisolle (back photo), French-born UN Forces veterans who participated in the Korean War, to a procession vehicle. Their interment ceremony will be held at the UN Memorial Cemetery in Nam-gu, Busan, on the afternoon of the 27th.

spans.text: Hannam Sayeoniri Oreum Forest Reopens with Expanded Visitor Capacity
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: Hannam Sayeoniri Oreum Forest, one of the “100 Best Forests in South Korea” designated by the Korea Forest Service, will remain open until October. It had been closed since November of last year during the “wildfire caution period” and is reopening after about six months. The daily visitor capacity has also been expanded from 300 to 400, an increase of 100 people. A source from the Korea Forest Service stated, “As approximately 30,000 people visited the trail during last year’s open period, we aimed to allow more visitors to enjoy the forest this year.”
spans.gt_tgt: 산림청이 지정한 ‘대한민국 100대 명품 숲’ 중 한 곳인 제주 서귀포시 한남사려니오름숲이 오는 10월까지 개방된다. 작년 11월 ‘산불 조심 기간’에 맞춰 폐쇄됐다가 6개월여 만에 다시 문을 여는 것이다. 하루 탐방 인원도 기존 300명에서 100명 늘어난 400명으로 확대했다. 산림청 관계자는 “작년 개방 기간 총 3만명이 탐방로를 찾은 만큼, 올해는 더 많은 탐방객이 숲길을 즐길 수 있게 한 것”이라고 했다.

spans.text: Former President Yoon Suk-yeol was sentenced to seven years in prison on the 29th of last month in a trial related to charges of abuse of authority. The harsher sentence in the appeal trial compared to the first trial stemmed from the reversal of not-guilty verdicts on charges, including instructing foreign media to disseminate false public statements after the December 3rd emergency martial law declaration. While the first trial ruled that even if the content of public statements by the overseas publicity secretary differed from facts, it did not infringe on the people’s right to know, the appeal court noted that in today’s open South Korean society, foreign media reports could spread domestically and affect the people’s right to know.
spans.gt_tgt: 윤석열 전 대통령은 지난달 29일 열린 직권남용 등 혐의 재판에서 징역 7년을 선고받았다. 항소심에서 1심보다 높은 형량이 선고된 건 12·3 비상계엄 선포 후 외신에 허위 공보를 지시한 혐의 등이 유죄로 뒤집혔기 때문이다. 1심은 해외홍보비서관의 공보 내용이 사실과 다르더라도 국민의 알 권리를 침해하지 않는다고 본 반면 항소심은 오늘날 개방된 대한민국 사회에서 외신 보도가 국내에 전파돼 국민의 알 권리에 영향을 미칠 수 있다고 지적했다.

spans.text: The government allocated 654 billion Korean won to support private companies in replacing outdated equipment to prevent industrial accidents. spans.text: Korea Exchange Discloses 120-220 Low P/B Firms
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: The Korea Exchange will publicly disclose a list of listed companies with stock prices below their book value under the new low P/B (price-to-book) ratio disclosure system on November 2. The P/B ratio is calculated by dividing a company’s market capitalization by its equity (net assets). A ratio below 1 indicates that the market value assigned by investors is lower than the company’s book value. Market analysts predict the system will accelerate share buybacks, cancellations, and dividend expansions among listed firms.
spans.gt_tgt: 주가가 회사 장부상 순자산에 못 미치는 상장사 중 일부를 한국거래소가 직접 공개하는 저PBR(주가순자산비율) 기업 공표제도가 오는 11월 2일 첫 명단을 내놓는다. PBR은 시가총액을 자기자본(순자산)으로 나눈 값이다. 1배를 밑돌면 주식시장이 매긴 회사 값이 장부상 재산보다 작다는 뜻이다. 증권가에서는 이 제도가 상장사들의 자사주 매입·소각과 배당 확대를 앞당기는 계기가 될 것이라는 전망이 나온다.

spans.text: National Museum of Korea's Sign Language Avatars Largely Nonfunctional

spans.text: On August 30, an unmanned information kiosk at the first-floor information desk of the National Museum of Korea (NMOK) in Yongsan-gu, Seoul. When the sign language (SL) guide button for the “acorn storage pit,” a Neolithic artifact, was pressed, an avatar in a gray jacket appeared on the screen. However, no explanation of the artifact followed. The avatar on the screen formed an “O” shape with its right thumb and index finger, pressed it to its forehead, then lowered it while spreading its fingers. This gesture means “I’m sorry,” indicating that the SL interpretation was not available.
spans.gt_tgt: 30일 서울 용산구 국립중앙박물관(국중박) 1층 안내 데스크의 무인안내기. 신석기 시대 유물인 ‘도토리 저장공’에 대한 수어(手語) 안내 버튼을 누르자 회색 재킷을 입은 아바타가 화면에 등장했다. 하지만 유물 설명은 나오지 않았다. 화면 속 아바타는 오른손 엄지와 검지를 붙여 ‘O’ 모양을 만든 뒤 이마에 대고 아래로 내리며 손가락을 폈다. “죄송합니다”라는 뜻으로, 수어 해설이 준비돼 있지 않다는 것이다.

spans.text: As the government announced plans to relocate government ministries and public institutions to regional areas this week, it was revealed on August 23 that the Financial Supervisory Service (FSS), known to be moving from Seoul to Sejong, has seen over 100 employees retire annually. An internal FSS survey found that 85.6% of respondents answered, “I will consider changing jobs if the relocation is pushed forward.”

spans.text: Chronic Illness Absences Risk Grade Retention
spans.gt_tgt: 가족 여행은 출석 인정하는데… 만성질환 아이는 결석·유급 걱정
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: Jung Ro-woon, an 11-year-old elementary school student living in Daejeon, has been suffering from Crohn’s disease, a chronic inflammatory bowel disease, since the age of five. Jung, who receives treatment at a university hospital in Seoul every six weeks, frequently experiences abdominal pain. Every Tuesday, after taking immunosuppressants, the following day becomes more physically challenging, leading to repeated tardiness and early leave. However, even on days when he travels to Seoul for treatment or experiences severe pain, he usually goes to school first. This is because failing to meet two-thirds of the required attendance days could result in grade retention.
spans.gt_tgt: 대전에 사는 초등학생 정로운(11)군은 5살 때부터 만성 염증성 장질환인 크론병을 앓고 있다. 6주마다 서울의 한 대학병원에서 치료를 받고 있는 정군은 수시로 복통에 시달린다. 매주 화요일 면역억제제를 복용하면 다음 날은 몸이 더 힘들어져 지각과 조퇴를 반복한다. 하지만 치료를 위해 서울에 올라오는 날도, 통증이 심한 날도 웬만하면 일단 학교에 간다. 출석 일수가 수업 일수의 3분의 2에 못 미치면 유급이 될 수 있기 때문이다.

spans.text: Exclusive: 163,000 Rise in Basic Livelihood Recipients Tied to 500,000 Won Coupons
spans.gt_tgt: [단독] 소비쿠폰 50만원까지 받기 위해? 작년 기초수급자 16만명 급증

spans.text: The Ministry of Health and Welfare was confirmed on the 16th to have initiated a research project to identify the reasons behind the unprecedented surge in basic livelihood security recipients (households with a monthly income of 765,444 Korean won or less for single-person households) last year. This has raised the possibility that low-income elderly individuals may have become recipients to receive up to 500,000 Korean won in “livelihood recovery consumption coupons” distributed by the government from July to September last year. At the time, the government provided differentiated amounts: 250,000 Korean won for the general public, 400,000 Korean won for the near-poor class, and 500,000 Korean won for basic livelihood security recipients.
spans.gt_tgt: 보건복지부가 지난해 이례적으로 기초생활수급자(1인 가구 기준 월소득 76만5444원 이하)가 급증한 원인을 파악하기 위해 연구용역에 착수한 것으로 16일 확인됐다. 이를 놓고 정부가 지난해 7~9월 지급한 ‘민생 회복 소비 쿠폰’을 최대 50만원까지 받기 위해 저소득 노인들이 수급자가 됐을 가능성이 제기되고 있다. 당시 정부는 소비 쿠폰을 일반 국민에게 25만원, 차상위계층에 40만원, 기초생활수급자에게는 50만원을 각각 차등 지급했다.

spans.text: Island Villages Face Water Crisis as Crops Wither in Severe Drought
spans.gt_tgt: 옥수수 타 죽고 섬 물탱크 '바닥'… 사람 먹고 쓸 물도 모자란다
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: On the morning of the 12th, Chudo Island in Sanyang Township, Tongyeong City, Gyeongnam Province. Located 20 kilometers from the mainland, the island spans 1.6 square kilometers. Its population is around 150 residents. Without a public water supply system, residents rely on groundwater and stream water. Villagers said, “Due to the drought, we are recycling water two or three times to survive as the groundwater dries up.” Chudo has been implementing water rationing since spring. Villages with better groundwater conditions receive water for three hours a day, while others get it once every three days, lasting a maximum of two hours. Residents noted, “When water flows, we fill every available container—rubber basins, PET bottles, kettles—without discrimination. This is our lifeline.” One resident added, “We use rice-washing water for hand laundry” and emphasized, “We repeatedly urge tourists to conserve water.”
spans.gt_tgt: 12일 오전 경남 통영시 산양읍 추도. 육지에서 20㎞ 떨어진 1.6㎢ 섬이다. 주민은 150여 명이다. 상수도가 설치돼 있지 않아 지하수와 계곡물에 기대 산다. 섬마을 주민들은 “가뭄에 지하수가 말라 물을 두 번, 세 번 재활용하며 버티고 있다”고 했다. 추도는 올봄부터 제한 급수를 하고 있다. 지하수 사정이 나은 마을은 하루 3시간, 그렇지 않은 곳은 사흘에 한 번, 길어야 2시간 정도만 물이 나온다. 주민들은 “물 나오는 시간만 되면 집에 있는 고무 대야, 페트병, 주전자 등 가릴 것 없이 물을 채운다”며 “이게 우리 생명줄”이라고 했다. 한 주민은 “쌀 씻은 물로 손빨래를 한다”며 “관광객들에게도 ‘물을 아껴 써달라’고 신신당부하고 있다”고 했다.

spans.text: On August 11, a reservoir in Chodong-myeon, Miryang City, South Gyeongsang Province, exposed its bed. It appeared parched and cracked due to an extreme heatwave and drought. The fire authorities issued the **National Fire Mobilization Order** on the same day, mobilizing firefighting resources nationwide. The authorities stated, “We plan to supply agricultural and domestic water by deploying 200 water tankers nationwide to the South Gyeongsang Province region from August 12 to 13.” This marks the second time the National Fire Mobilization Order has been issued due to drought, following last August in Gangneung, Gangwon Province.

spans.text: Shade Apps, Short Deliveries Combat Seoul Heat
spans.gt_tgt: "길 건너야 덜 더워요" 그늘앱 쓰고, 100m 초단거리 배달 시키고
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: The temperature in Seoul’s Yeongdeungpo District reached 40 degrees Celsius at 1 p.m. on the 6th. Jin Sungmin (26), an office worker in Yeouido, pulled out his phone immediately after leaving a restaurant for lunch. He wanted to find the shadiest route back to his office. After entering his destination into the smartphone app “Geu-neul-lo,” several recommended paths appeared, including “shortest distance” and “shaded path.” Choosing the shaded path displayed a route on the map with the guidance “48% shade,” meaning he could walk half the distance under shade during the 10-minute walk to his office. “I used to take the shortest route, but these days I look for shaded paths even if it means crossing the street,” he said.

spans.text: U.S. Marine Corps First FPV Drone Live-Fire in Korea

spans.text: The temperature soared above 37 degrees Celsius on August 5 at the Rodriguez Live Fire Complex in Yeongpyeong-ri, Yeongjung-myeon, Pocheon, Gyeonggi Province, when a low voice saying “Splash” was heard over the radio. A red flash erupted from a target approximately 2.5 kilometers away from the command post, followed by an explosion three seconds later. This marked the first live-fire training exercise in the Korean Peninsula by the U.S. Marine Corps using first-person view (FPV) attack drones. FPV drones allow operators to control the drones from the aircraft’s perspective via real-time video feed from a front-mounted camera transmitted to specialized goggles, enabling high precision. This was the first time the U.S. military publicly disclosed such a live-fire training exercise for suicide drones conducted domestically.

spans.text: The government will significantly scale back the ‘labor union accounting disclosure system’ introduced in 2023. spans.text: The Korea Refugee Film Festival (KOREFF) was held on June 17 at Art House Momo in Seoul. Organized annually on June 20 to commemorate World Refugee Day, the festival is a non-profit human rights film event co-hosted by the Refugee Human Rights Network and the UNHCR Korea Representative Office. This year, marking its 10th anniversary, the festival screened the short film *Allies in Exile* by Syrian refugee director Hassan Kattan. The 40-minute documentary chronicles Kattan’s experience applying for refugee status in the UK and waiting for the result, recorded on camera and smartphone, after he exposed the horrors of the Syrian civil war to the outside world.
spans.gt_tgt: 난민영화제(KOREFF)가 지난달 17일 서울 아트하우스 모모에서 열렸다. 매년 6월 20일 세계 난민의 날을 기념해 난민인권네트워크와 유엔난민기구(UNHCR) 한국대표부가 공동 주최하는 비영리 인권 영화제다. 10회째를 맞은 올해에는 시리아 난민 하산 카탄 감독의 단편 영화 ‘피난의 동지들(Allies in Exile)’이 상영됐다. 시리아 내전의 참상을 외부에 알려온 카탄이 영국에서 난민 지위를 신청한 뒤 결과를 기다리며 겪은 일을 카메라와 스마트폰으로 기록한 40분짜리 다큐멘터리다.

spans.text: National Diplomatic Academy Data Breach Undetected 10 Months
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: Personal information of up to 10,000 individuals, including South Korean diplomats and overseas mission staff, was leaked after the internal education system of the National Diplomatic Academy under the Ministry of Foreign Affairs was hacked, it was revealed on the 21st. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has approximately 2,500 employees, and the breach may have exposed names, positions, and email addresses of most overseas mission staff, including defense attachés dispatched from the Ministry of National Defense and resident officers from the National Intelligence Service (NIS). While the perpetrators remain unidentified, possibilities of involvement by North Korea or China cannot be ruled out. However, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated it is “comprehensively considering” whether to request an external investigation.
spans.gt_tgt: 우리 외교관과 해외 공관 주재관 등 최대 1만여 명의 개인 정보가 저장된 외교부 산하 국립외교원의 내부 교육 시스템이 해킹당한 것으로 21일 전해졌다. 외교부 직원 수는 약 2500명으로 국방부 파견 무관과 국정원 파견 주재관을 포함한 타 부처 출신까지 해외 공관 근무자 대부분의 이름, 직책, 이메일 주소 등이 유출됐을 가능성이 제기된다. 해킹 주체는 아직 파악되지 않았지만, 북한이나 중국 등일 가능성을 배제할 수 없는 것으로 전해졌다. 그러나 외교부는 외부 기관 수사 의뢰 여부에 대해 “종합적으로 고려 중”이라고 밝혔다.

spans.text: “Whether the weather is good, bad, or just right, every day is good.” There is a travel destination that fits this famous line from the drama *Guardian: The Lonely and Great God*. It is Pyeongchang, Gangwon Province. “But summer is for the sea,” you say? You don’t know the half of it. From July 23 to August 2—the so-called “vacation gold season”—Pyeongchang, including Daegwallyeong, will host the *Pyeongchang Daegwallyeong Music Festival*, adding a classical music extravaganza to the region. The main venues are the Alpenxia Concert Hall and the Daegwallyeong Outdoor Stage, but depending on the date, concerts will also take place at major attractions like the Monaryongpyeong Fir Healing Forest, Woljeongsa Temple’s Relics Museum, and more. Using this as an excuse, we set out to find Pyeongchang’s healing and summer retreat spots that are good whether the weather is clear, rainy, or windy.
spans.gt_tgt: “날이 좋아서, 날이 좋지 않아서, 날이 적당해서, 모든 날이 좋았다.” 드라마 ‘도깨비’ 속 명대사가 어울리는 여행지가 있다. 강원도 평창이다. “그래도 여름엔 바다”라고? 모르시는 말씀이다. 이른바 ‘바캉스 골드 시즌’인 7월 23일부터 8월 2일까지 대관령을 포함한 평창 곳곳은 ‘평창대관령음악제’ 개최로 클래식의 향연이 더해진다. 주 무대인 알펜시아 콘서트홀, 대관령 야외 공연장뿐 아니라 날짜에 따라 모나용평의 가문비치유숲, 월정사 성보박물관 등 굵직한 명소에서도 음악회가 열린다. 이를 핑계 삼아 여름 방학을 알차게 보낼 평창의 힐링, 피서 명소를 찾아 나섰다. 맑으면 맑은 대로, 비가 오면 비가 오는 대로, 바람 불면 바람 부는 대로 좋은 그곳으로.

spans.text: Safety Measures Backfire as Employer Status Evidence for Contractors
spans.gt_tgt: 안전 CCTV 설치했다고, 안전앱 제공했다고… 사용자로 판단

spans.text: Companies’ safety measures such as inspections, risk assessments, and other mandatory obligations under the Industrial Safety and Health Act (ISHA) for subcontractors have been used by labor committees as grounds to recognize the “employer” status of primary contractors (“real employer” status) in subcontracting relationships. In some cases, primary contractors’ actions—such as sending disciplinary texts for safety violations by subcontract workers, conducting alcohol tests, or installing restrooms—were cited as evidence of their control over subcontractors. Businesses have protested, arguing that “failure to rigorously manage subcontractors’ safety could lead to violations of ISHA or the Serious Accidents Punishment Act, while proactive safety management could result in being recognized as an employer, forcing them to negotiate with subcontractors’ unions—a structurally unfair situation.”
spans.gt_tgt: 기업들이 산업안전보건법(산안법) 준수를 위해 하청업체를 대상으로 시행한 안전 점검, 위험성 평가 등의 각종 안전 의무 조치들이 노동위원회에서 원·하청 간 사용자성(‘진짜 사장’ 여부) 인정 근거로 활용된 것으로 나타났다. 하청 근로자가 안전 수칙을 위반할 때 보내는 제재 문자, 음주 측정, 화장실 설치 등을 원청이 맡아서 했다는 게 판단 근거가 된 경우도 있었다. 기업들 사이에선 “하청에 대한 안전 관리를 철저히 안 하면 산안법, 더 나아가 중대재해처벌법 위반이 될 수 있고, 안전 관리에 힘쓰면 사용자로 인정돼 하청의 교섭 요구에 응해야 하는 불합리한 구조”라는 반발이 나온다.

spans.text: The National Election Commission maintains 22 overseas election officers in nine countries even in non-election years to prepare for overseas voting. Based on a two-year dispatch period, approximately 150 million Korean won is spent per person. Overseas elections occur during presidential and parliamentary elections, with 14.3 billion Korean won allocated for the 2024 National Assembly election and 11.6 billion Korean won for last year’s presidential election. Costs include operational expenses for polling stations at overseas missions, air and logistics fees for sending and returning ballots, promotional expenses, equipment rental, and network infrastructure setup. Based on approximately 1.97 million overseas citizens, the overseas voter turnout was 4.7% in the 2024 general election and 10.4% in the 2025 presidential election.

spans.text: ‘Even now, I miss the sea that comes to mind,/ the memory of mountain ridges filled with wild chrysanthemums./ The islands visible from there,/ up to the daylight of those white waves,/ I tried to meet the heart of the Lord/ who placed them as the backdrop to my life and existence.// Now,/ I still live on an island./ The steps of middle age pause and pass somewhere,/ I walk along the riverbank scattered with cosmos/ that someone sowed and harvested./ Even if deeper or higher places have worn flat,/ my sea, my breaths/ are full on the mountain of life…’ (‘Adult Island, Young Boy’)
spans.gt_tgt: ‘지금 생각해도 그립고 저며 오는 바다와/ 들국화 가득한 산허리의 기억./ 그곳에서 멀리 보이던 섬들,/ 그 흰 파도의 날빛까지/ 내 삶과 인생의 배경으로 놓아 두셨던/ 주인이신 분의 마음을 만나려 했습니다.// 지금/ 여전히 나는 섬에 삽니다./ 중년의 걸음이 어느 곳에 머물다 지나치고/ 누군가 뿌려 주고, 거두어 가는/ 코스모스 흐드러진 강변을 걷습니다./ 더 깊거나 높은 곳은 닳아 평평해졌어도/ 나의 바다는, 나의 숨들은/ 인생의 산에 가득하다 하겠습니다.…’(‘어른 섬 어린 소년’)

spans.text: On the afternoon of the 14th, parts of Seoul and Gyeonggi Province experienced heavy showers of around 30 mm per hour. A heavy rain advisory was issued in Seoul for the first time this year. Hail also fell in Suwon, Paju, and Pocheon in Gyeonggi Province. The photo shows hailstones on a roadside in Yeongtong-gu, Suwon. A professional baseball game in Suwon was also canceled. The Korea Meteorological Administration stated, “Showers and hail occurred in many areas as the atmosphere became unstable,” and forecasted, “After the 15th, most regions across the country will generally be clear, with daytime temperatures rising above 30 degrees Celsius, leading to hot weather.”

spans.text: Songpa-gu Election Commission Fails to Stamp Ballot Serials
spans.gt_tgt: 오전부터 투표지 동날 조짐… 송파 선관위는 일련번호 찍는 법도 몰라
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: On the day of the 6·3 local elections, signs of a ballot paper shortage were detected in Songpa-gu, Seoul, from the morning. However, Songpa-gu Election Commission staff reportedly did not even know how to stamp serial numbers on reserve ballot papers, leading to confusion. They also failed to report the situation to the Seoul Election Commission and the National Election Commission in a timely manner. The commission had no guidelines for addressing ballot shortages, and staff were unprepared to distribute reserve ballot papers swiftly. The National Election Commission’s Truth Investigation Committee disclosed these facts on the 12th, stating, “There was systemic incompetence.”
spans.gt_tgt: 6·3 지방선거 당일 서울 송파구에서 오전부터 투표용지 부족 조짐이 감지됐지만, 송파구선관위 직원들은 예비 용지에 일련번호 찍는 법도 제대로 몰라 우왕좌왕하며 서울시선관위와 중앙선관위에 제때 보고조차 하지 못한 것으로 나타났다. 선관위에는 투표용지가 부족한 경우에 대비한 지침이 없었고, 직원들은 예비 투표용지를 신속 배분하는 연습이 돼 있지 않았다. 중앙선거관리위원회 진상규명위원회는 12일 이런 사실을 공개하며 “총체적 부실”이 있었다고 발표했다.

spans.text: Evacuation Schools: Birthplace of South Korea's Postwar Miracle
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: During the Japanese colonial period, the new school year began in April, but this was changed to September during the US military government period. The adjustment aimed to align with the start of the academic year in the US and Europe, but it did not align well with Korea’s accounting year, which began in April. In March 1950, the Ministry of Education decided to revert the start of the new school year to April and, as an interim measure, began the 1950 school year on June 1. Less than a month after the new school year began that year, the Korean War broke out on June 25.
spans.gt_tgt: 일제강점기 신학년의 시작은 4월이었지만, 미 군정기 9월로 변경됐다. 미국·유럽의 신학년 시작 시기와 일치시키기 위한 조정이었지만, 4월부터 시작되는 한국의 회계 연도와는 잘 맞지 않았다. 1950년 3월, 문교부는 신학년 시작을 4월로 환원할 것을 결정하고, 그 중간 단계로 1950년 신학년은 6월 1일 시작했다. 그해 신학년이 시작된 지 채 한 달이 지나지 않아 6·25전쟁이 발발했다.

spans.text: The Supreme Court has ruled that non-medical professionals cannot be punished for performing cosmetic tattoo procedures such as eyebrow and hairline tattoos. This marks the first case where the court applied its revised precedent, established last month by the Supreme Court en banc after 34 years, which stated, “Cosmetic tattoo procedures performed by non-medical professionals do not constitute unlicensed medical practice.”

spans.text: Young people in their 20s and 30s stood at the center of the “Jamsil Suffrage Rally,” protesting the shortage of ballots in the June 3 local elections. During the weekend (June 6–7) rally, which drew approximately 38,000 citizens, 70–80% of participants were in their 20s and 30s. They voiced a unified demand: “Fairness and suffrage have been violated.” The young attendees did not distinguish between ideologies or political factions and warned those raising political slogans, “Do not contaminate the rally.”

spans.text: The number of cases received by the Labor Commission up to April this year has increased by approximately 45% compared to the same period last year. spans.text: On the third day of the ninth nationwide simultaneous local elections, an unprecedented situation occurred as voting was temporarily suspended at over 10 polling stations in Seoul and other areas due to a shortage of ballots. At some polling stations, voters waited over 1 hour and 30 minutes due to the lack of ballots, while others gave up and left without voting. Some polling stations extended the voting deadline from 6 p.m. to 10 p.m. The People Power Party demanded a halt to the vote count, calling it a "grave violation of voters' suffrage rights," and argued that a re-election should be held depending on the investigation results.

spans.text: Mr. Lee, a 50-something office worker, held a funeral for his late mother at a funeral home in Incheon last November. His colleagues and friends only learned of the death days later. spans.text: Bukhansan's Peaks: Timeless Guardians of Seoul
spans.gt_tgt: 북한산 백운대, 인수봉… 세월이 머문 자리
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: Bukhansan, which guards the northern part of Seoul like a folding screen, is a granite mountain that rose due to tectonic movements between the Jurassic and Cretaceous periods of the Mesozoic era, approximately 170 million years ago. Its highest peak, Baegundae (837 meters), along with Insubong (811 meters) to the north and Mangyeongdae (800 meters) to the south, form a triangular shape with their three horn-like peaks. For a long time, it was called Samgaksan (Three Peaks Mountain). After the Qing invasion of Joseon in 1636, Kim Sang-heon, an anti-Qing faction scholar, was taken to the Qing Dynasty in 1640. He lamented, “Farewell, Samgaksan, until we meet again, Han River.” From the late Joseon period, it was also called Bukhansan (Northern Han Mountain) because it lies north of Hanyang (old Seoul), a name that continues today.
spans.gt_tgt: 서울 북쪽을 병풍처럼 지켜주고 있는 북한산은 최고봉인 백운대(837m)와 그 북쪽의 인수봉(811m), 남쪽의 만경대(800m), 이들 뿔 모양 세 봉우리가 삼각형 모양을 이루고 있어 오랜 세월 삼각산(三角山)으로 불렸다. 병자호란 이후인 1640년 척화파 김상헌이 청나라로 끌려가면서 “가노라 삼각산아, 다시 보자 한강수야”라고 읊조렸던 그 산이다. 조선 후기부터는 한성의 북쪽에 있는 산이라 하여 북한산(北漢山)으로도 불리게 됐으며, 이것이 오늘날 이름으로 이어지고 있다.

spans.text: Sinkholes, often referred to as “underground landmines” due to the sudden collapse of seemingly stable ground, have been increasingly causing damage across South Korea. spans.text: On the morning of the 1st, 120,000 people flocked to Seoul Forest in Seongsu-dong, Seoul. On the first day of a free Pokémon commemorative item giveaway event held in the area, 40,000 people also rushed to nearby cafe streets. This was because the item was a limited-edition card celebrating this year’s 30th anniversary of Pokémon’s creation, featuring the koi fish character (Koi King). The event was so frenzied that it had to be halted due to safety concerns. Some camped out overnight, and enthusiasts from Japan and China even traveled to attend. Resellers, who had been offering to buy the cards on the spot for around 100,000 Korean won each since a month prior, were actively conducting business. The cards, which have skyrocketed in value, include promotional Pokémon cards distributed for free in Jamsil, Seoul, last year, now fetching over 600,000 Korean won in the secondhand market.

spans.gt_tgt: 빙하 녹으며 홍수, 발전소 파괴… 5년전 인도 '차몰리 비극' 닮은꼴

spans.text: On February 7, 2021, at around 10:21 a.m., a rock face and the glacier covering it collapsed at an elevation of approximately 5,500 meters on the Ronti Peak in the Indian Himalayas. The volume of the collapsed rock and ice was about 27 million cubic meters, enough to fill approximately 9,000 Olympic-standard swimming pools (2.5 meters deep). This massive mass rushed down the steep mountain slope into the valley, transforming into a rapid flow of water and rocks that engulfed the downstream area. The Rishi Ganga and Tapovan Vishnugad hydropower plants, which were under construction, suffered severe damage. Over 200 people died or went missing. This was the Chamoli disaster in northern India.
spans.gt_tgt: 2021년 2월 7일 오전 10시 21분쯤, 인도 히말라야 론티봉의 해발 약 5500m 지점에서 암반과 그 위를 덮고 있던 빙하가 함께 떨어져 나갔다. 무너진 암석과 얼음은 약 2700만㎥로, 올림픽 규격 수영장(깊이 2.5m 기준) 약 9000개를 채울 양이었다. 이 거대한 덩어리는 가파른 산비탈을 타고 계곡으로 쏟아져 내렸고, 물과 바위가 뒤섞인 급류로 변해 하류를 덮쳤다. 리시강가 수력발전소와 건설 중이던 타포반 비슈누가드 수력발전소가 심각한 피해를 봤다. 200명 넘는 사람이 숨지거나 실종됐다. 인도 북부에 있는 차몰리(Chamoli) 참사다.

spans.text: Korea's 1.1T 'Nobel Prize Factory' Rises from Pohang Expertise
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: Construction has begun on the ‘Korea Light Source (KLS)’ in Ochang, Cheongju, Chungcheongbuk-do, a facility spanning an area equivalent to 75 soccer fields and requiring an investment of 1.1643 trillion Korean won. This 4th-generation synchrotron accelerates electrons to near-light speeds, producing intense beams of light that act as a “giant microscope” to observe atomic arrangements and states of matter. While conventional microscopes can magnify small objects, synchrotrons—dubbed “dream microscopes”—can illuminate atoms and molecules with brightness and clarity millions of times greater. Basic science applications include developing smaller and faster chips, longer-lasting batteries, protein structure analysis for drug discovery, and identifying new materials.
spans.gt_tgt: 충북 청주 오창에서 최근 축구장 75개 크기 부지에 사업비 1조1643억원이 들어가는 ‘한국새빛가속기’ 건설이 시작됐다. 이는 4세대 방사광가속기로, 전자를 빛에 가까운 속도로 가속해 만든 강한 빛으로 물질의 원자 배열과 상태를 들여다보는 ‘초대형 현미경’이다. 일반 현미경으로는 작은 물체를 볼 수 있지만 꿈의 현미경으로 불리는 방사광가속기는 원자나 분자 수준까지 수백만 배 밝고 선명하게 볼 수 있다. 기초과학은 더 작고 빠른 칩 개발, 더 오래가는 배터리 개발, 단백질 구조 분석을 통한 치료제 개발, 새로운 물질 발견 등 최신 기술 연구에 활용된다.

spans.text: AI Firms Develop Chips, Chipmakers Build Models

spans.text: The boundaries between semiconductors and models, the two pillars of the artificial intelligence (AI) industry, are rapidly dissolving. Model companies like Anthropic and OpenAI are developing their own chips, while semiconductor firms such as NVIDIA and AMD are expanding into AI models. This shift aims to reduce dependence on external partners, lower costs and supply risks, and seize direct control over the AI ecosystem. Analysts note that the AI competition has moved beyond individual chip or model performance, evolving into a "full-stack" war encompassing all elements required to power AI.
spans.gt_tgt: 인공지능(AI) 산업의 양대 축인 반도체와 모델의 경계가 빠르게 허물어지고 있다. 앤스로픽·오픈AI 등 모델 기업은 자체 칩 개발에 나섰고, 엔비디아·AMD 등 반도체 기업은 AI 모델로 사업 영역을 넓히는 것이다. 외부 기업에 대한 의존도를 낮춰 비용과 공급 위험을 줄이고, AI 생태계의 주도권을 직접 쥐기 위해서다. AI 경쟁이 개별 칩이나 모델의 성능을 겨루는 단계를 넘어서, AI 구동에 필요한 모든 요소를 아우르는 ‘풀스택(full-stack)’ 전쟁으로 나아가고 있다는 분석이 나온다.

spans.text: Hyundai Motor Company’s union staged a full-scale strike for one day on the 21st, halting production lines at all domestic factories, including Ulsan, Jeonju, and Asan. This marks the first full-scale strike by the Hyundai union in a decade since 2016. The union, which has been conducting partial strikes since last month amid stalled wage and labor condition negotiations with management, escalated to a full strike to pressure the company. spans.text: On August 7 at 1 p.m., a breath as cold as frost emerged as one entered the ‘Zeta Smart Center,’ a large logistics warehouse of Lotte Mart in Busan’s Gangseo District, where temperatures had soared to 37.8 degrees Celsius. Amid the chilly air, 150 unmanned transport robots ceaselessly moved across grid-like storage facilities. When a customer ordered products online, a transport robot lifted a stock box containing over 10 packs of lettuce and placed it in front of a nearby robotic arm. The robotic arm picked one pack and transferred it into a customer delivery box. The box then slid down a transparent cylinder to the lower floor and was loaded onto a delivery vehicle.
spans.gt_tgt: 지난 7일 오후 1시, 기온이 37.8도까지 치솟은 부산 강서구에서 롯데마트의 대형 물류 창고인 ‘제타 스마트센터’에 들어서자 서리와 같은 입김이 나왔다. 냉장 구역은 영상 3~5도, 냉동 구역은 영하 25도였다. 찬 공기 속에서 무인 운반 로봇 150대는 바둑판 모양의 보관 설비 위를 쉴 새 없이 오갔다. 온라인에서 고객이 상품을 주문하자 운반 로봇이 상추 10여 봉지가 든 재고 박스를 들어 인근의 로봇 팔 앞에 갖다 놓았다. 로봇 팔이 이 중 한 봉지를 집어 고객 배송 박스에 옮겨 담았다. 박스는 투명한 원통을 타고 아래층으로 내려가 배송 차량에 실렸다.

spans.text: Triple Tax Trap Ensnares Elderly Homeowners
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: President Lee Jae Myung said at a Cabinet meeting held at Cheong Wa Dae on the 4th, “It is right to reduce taxes for those whose primary residence’s value has risen coincidentally through living there, but if someone buys property for investment or speculation and earns billions of won while paying almost no taxes, it is unfair compared to workers’ earned income.” This explained the 2025 tax reform plan, which significantly increases taxes for non-resident and ultra-high-value single-homeowners. However, the reform plan drastically reduces tax deductions previously given to long-term apartment owners who held properties for 20–30 years or more. Critics argue that the reform’s biggest victims will not be multi-home speculators but elderly residents who have lived in the same neighborhood for decades—those President Lee said “should have their taxes reduced.”
spans.gt_tgt: 이재명 대통령은 4일 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “살다 보니 우연히 실거주 집값이 오른 것은 깎아주는 게 맞지만, 투자·투기용으로 사서 수십억원을 버는데 세금을 거의 안 낸다면 노동자들의 근로소득과 형평이 안 맞는다”고 말했다. 비거주·초고가 1주택자의 세금을 대폭 올린, 내년도 세제개편안을 설명한 것이다. 하지만 정작 개편안은 20~30년 이상 아파트를 장기 보유한 소유자에게 주던 공제 혜택을 대거 축소했다. 개편안의 최대 피해자가 다주택 투기 세력이 아니라 대통령이 “깎아주는 게 맞다”고 한, 수십 년을 한 동네에서 살아온 고령층이 될 것이란 지적이 나온다.

spans.text: Samsung, SK Hynix Semiconductors Power South Korea's $44.8B Export Record
spans.why: Editorial layer. Official target edition already rewrote it.

spans.text: On July 30, airline employees at Incheon International Airport Cargo Terminal loaded semiconductors from Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix onto a Korean Air Cargo flight bound for Hong Kong. Semiconductors, being small, lightweight, sensitive to external shocks, and requiring rapid transportation, are typically shipped by air rather than sea due to their high value. Driven by a "supercycle" fueled by surging demand for artificial intelligence (AI) data centers, semiconductors achieved a record monthly export of $44.82 billion in June. This helped South Korea become the fourth country globally, after Germany, China, and the United States, to surpass $100 billion in monthly exports. The semiconductor-led export growth continued into July.
spans.gt_tgt: 지난달 30일 인천국제공항 화물터미널에서 항공사 직원들이 홍콩으로 향하는 대한항공 화물기에 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스의 반도체를 싣고 있다. 반도체는 작고 가벼운 데다, 외부 충격에 민감하고, 빠른 운송이 중요한 고부가가치 화물이라 선박 대신 비행기로 운송한다. 인공지능(AI) 데이터센터 수요 폭증에 따른 ‘수퍼사이클’로 반도체는 지난 6월 역대 최대 수출(448억2000만달러) 기록을 썼다. 덕분에 한국도 독일·중국·미국에 이어 세계 네 번째로 월 수출 1000억달러를 달성한 국가가 됐다. 7월에도 반도체 주도의 수출 호조가 이어졌다.

spans.text: AI-Driven NAND Flash Surge Narrows Gap with DRAM
spans.gt_tgt: AI 기술 고도화… 낸드플래시 몸값도 D램 못지않게 뛰어

spans.text: In the current global memory market, NAND flash has seen its value surge as much, if not more, than DRAM and high-bandwidth memory (HBM). While DRAM is a “volatile memory” that temporarily stores data, NAND flash is a “storage memory” that retains data even when powered off. As artificial intelligence (AI) technology advances, the importance of NAND flash—which stores and retrieves vast amounts of data required for complex reasoning—has grown. Over the past six months, NAND flash prices have nearly tripled. Memory semiconductor companies are now aggressively competing to expand production facilities in the NAND sector.

spans.text: Following President Lee Jae Myung, Kim Yong-beom, the presidential chief of staff for policy, has also emphasized ‘real estate tax normalization,’ pushing the government’s real estate tax hike scenario into its final stages. Government-related departments are considering raising the fair market value ratio for comprehensive real estate tax assessments and strengthening tax burdens on multiple homeowners and high-value single-homeowners as key measures. spans.text: A radar capable of detecting autonomous drones will be introduced for the first time at a domestic nuclear power plant. This measure aims to strengthen the response system for domestic nuclear facilities following incidents such as the drone attack on the UAE’s Barakah Nuclear Power Plant last month, which highlighted the reality of aerial threats targeting nuclear sites.
spans.gt_tgt: 자율비행 드론까지 탐지할 수 있는 레이더가 국내 원자력발전소에 처음 도입된다. 지난달 아랍에미리트(UAE) 바라카 원전이 드론 공격을 받는 등 원전을 겨냥한 공중 위협이 현실화하자 국내 원전의 대응 체계를 강화하기 위한 조치다.
